## Join Gabe and the Campaign Wednesday Evening to Phone Bank at Satire Brewery
**___________________________________________________________________________**
Friend, We're only a few days out from the June 25th Primary and we need all hands on deck!

Satire Brewery has been gracious enough to donate a private space for phone banking. We'll be calling strong conservatives and reminding them to vote for Gabe and answering any questions they might have.

Scripts and additional talking points will be provided, and light refreshments will be available.
Information is also provided below, for our weekly door canvassing event on Saturday. **___________________________________________________________________________**
****
**_Phone Bank_**
******
When:** Wednesday, June 12th, 5:30 – 7:30pm
**
Where:** Satire Brewing Company 12136 Grant Cir, Thornton, CO

**___________________________________________________________________________**

**_Door Canvassing_**
Saturday, June 15th at 9:00am
*Training will begin at 8:30am (_Trying to beat the heat _)**

_South Location_**
Starbucks
__13671 Colorado Blvd. _**North Location:**_
11169 E I-25 Frontage Rd.
Firestone, CO 80504

* Training, literature and talking points provided.

* If this is your first time to knock doors, please ensure you have been set up on the Walk App (Numinar). For help getting onboarded, please contact Jessica at [Jessica@ElectGabeEvans.com](mailto:Jessica@ElectGabeEvans.com) or [(720) 691-0565](tel:\(720\) 691-0565). **___________________________________________________________________________**_

_ All the best,

Tyler Moore
Campaign Manager

| | Peter, Here in Alabama, we don’t need career politicians who are bought and paid for by coastal elites telling us what to do. We need good, old-fashioned Southerners with Alabama values who will get things DONE for our communities. As an attorney, mom, wife, and traditional conservative – I know how to get things done for the people I love. **Now, I’m running for Congress to get things done for YOU, Peter. I’m hoping you’ll join me in this fight for****Alabama’s 2nd Congressional District****. ** [**_SUPPORT CAROLEENE DOBSON FOR AL-02_**](https://links.dobsonforalabama.com/els/v2/q9bRT9r3g_M3/VkdaQkJoTFU5aTZweHg0VjhXRjUyM0FmZDJYUEx3bGFhSWpKOU5rTTlzcmNDQ29tTnUvQlRkdVdoeWg0SGI1Y0pVeWNIVFlmcmZBa3RGSkZ2Z1dMZWI3WUUyaEdqK2RJcGVVeVlUbnYxbVk9S0/) All too often, politicians get to Washington and completely forget that they aren’t there to represent themselves, special interest groups, or mega-donors... _**They’re in Washington to represent me and you, Peter. **_ _And I know you and I don’t want open borders..._ _We don’t want to see illegal immigrants prioritized ahead of American citizens..._ _We don’t want to defund our police force..._ So why is that what’s being pushed by so many representatives? | | Caroleene Dobson is a distinguished attorney, wife, mother, District Two resident, and a lifelong advocate for conservative values. Born and raised in Beatrice, Alabama, Dobson grew up on her family's fifth-generation cattle farm, where she learned the meaning of hard work and developed a firsthand understanding of the challenges faced by hardworking families and entrepreneurs. Currently practicing real estate law at the Maynard Nexsen law firm, Dobson represents a diverse clientele, including homebuilders, retailers, small business owners, and private landowners. She has spent her career advocating for her client’s interests while also achieving tangible, positive outcomes. In Congress, she will hold true to her core conservative values while ensuring Washington D.C. is working for the people of District Two. A passionate advocate for families, farms, and faith, Dobson aims to preserve the bedrock values and moral backbone that have defined our nation. With a call for Alabama common sense, she is determined to challenge the far-left agenda in Washington, D.C., advocating for the rights of property owners and defending the freedom to think, speak, and act without interference.Caroleene, alongside her husband Bobby, is the proud parent of two daughters, Philippa and Lydia. Her decision to run for Congress is deeply rooted in a desire to secure a future for her children and to champion the principles that have made America the land of the free.

[Click here](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-e-eddhjut-trihsurjy-tt/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhjut-trihsurjy-r/) [PLEASE CONSIDER DONATING TODAY](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhjut-trihsurjy-y/) Dear Friends,I recently sent you an email as the first installment in a series of responses to my opponent's **[justification of her vote for the $1.2 trillion Schumer/Biden omnibus spending bill.](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhjut-trihsurjy-j/)**[Our preference would be to have more robust debates, across the district, where we stand before voters to discuss these important issues. ](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhjut-trihsurjy-t/)However, our opponent seems unwilling to do more than one debate, so we will do our best to offer a positive comparison in writing and by video whenever possible. Today I will be breaking down her statements about the Wuhan Institute, and UNRWA funding "cuts" and the impact (or lack thereof) of this bill and border security. [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhjut-trihsurjy-i/)
### **WUHAN/UNRWA FUNDING CUTS**
### **Celeste Claims:** This bill defunded the Wuhan Institute and the United Nations Relief and Works Agency (UNRWA). We have here one institution that allegedly started a global pandemic and another that has 13 employees being implicated for taking part in the Hamas attacks (_[see 1 below](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhjut-trihsurjy-d/)_).

**Colby Claims:** You don't get brownie points for that. Why would we EVER fund those organizations after what they have done?**The Truth:** The earmarks in this bill are a major problem for conservatives, and Celeste knows it.
* First, as a practical matter, you're never going to win in a game of trading earmarks with the Democrats, they will always find a way to outspend us.
* Second, Celeste claims that the Constitution demands Congress do their duty to fund the government, yet she readily funds unconstitutional earmarks.

I don't imagine the founders would have included in the sacred duty to fund the government a duty to fund earmarks for late-term abortion, gun confiscation, or the $400,000 to a group that gives transition clothing to trans minors and coordinates against parental rights groups(_[see 2 below](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhjut-trihsurjy-n/)_ _)_ that are in this bill Celeste voted for. **SECURING THE BORDER****Celeste Claims:** This bill increased ICE funding for detention beds and gave Border Patrol more funding to pay their agents overtime.**Colby Claims:** As conservative Congressman Chip Roy said, "This bill does not have one single policy necessary to secure the border" (_[see 3 below](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhjut-trihsurjy-p/)_) How can both be true?**The Truth:** Until we end catch-and-release, re-implement remain in Mexico, and, ideally, finish the wall, we are just rearranging deck chairs on the Titanic with any other border policy.
* Historically, 30% of agent time is spent processing illegal migrants and 70% actually out on patrol. With catch-and-release, people just come up to the border looking to be caught by border patrol and claim asylum. They then get a ride into town and are shipped all over the US while they await their hearing years later - which they may or may not ever show up to (_[see 4 below](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhjut-trihsurjy-x/)_).
* Because of that incentive structure, now agents are spending 90% of their time processing, and 10% of the time on the Border (_[see 5 below](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhjut-trihsurjy-m/)_).
* Until catch-and-release is ended, our Border Patrol agents are hardly more than a welcome committee and the detention beds are hardly more than free lodging.

More overtime and more beds do nothing but get illegal immigrants processed and into our country a bit more smoothly.Most insulting of all, and I can't emphasize this enough, **we paid $500 million to the government of Jordan to "enhance security along its borders" **(_[see 6 below](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhjut-trihsurjy-q/)). _Imagine if we had put that toward a border wall. _**1** Annabelle Timsit, Bryan Pietsch, and Sammy Westfall, Why Unrwa, the U.N. Agency for Palestinians, is losing funding..., January 29, 2024, [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/01/28/unrwa-funding-suspensions-hamas-gaza-israel/](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhjut-trihsurjy-a/).
**2** House Freedom Caucus, "$400,000 for Briarpatch Youth Services in Wisconsin.One of Their Programs Is Called 'Teens like Us LGBTQIA2S+' That Includes a 'Gender Affirming Clothing Program' for Ages 13-18\. Twitter, March 21, 2024, [https://twitter.com/freedomcaucus/status/1770843659430166693](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhjut-trihsurjy-f/)
**3** 118th United States Congress, "Congressman Chip Roy Speaks on the Swamp Bus: More Illegals, Less Freedom | Congressional Record | Congress.Gov | Library of Congress," congress.gov, March 21, 2024, [https://www.congress.gov/congressional-record/volume-170/issue-50/house-section/article/H1344-2](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhjut-trihsurjy-z/)
**4** Invasion on the Southern Border: The Divided States of Biden, 2024, [https://dwplus.watch/3a9j58wl](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhjut-trihsurjy-v/)
**5 **Invasion on the Southern Border: The Divided States of Biden, 2024, [https://dwplus.watch/3a9j58wl](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhjut-trihsurjy-e/)

body:
| I’ll get right to it:
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=2797%2E35263%2ErGg7T8)
Peter — I’ll get right to it: [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-jun24.Hijekx&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240611_PM2_V1_S1&t=4&akid=2797%2E35263%2ErGg7T8) As of today, Republicans have already poured more than $13 million into Wisconsin. My megamillionaire opponent, Eric Hovde, has loaned his campaign $8 million so far, and he’s promised to spend at least $20 million of his own personal fortune to defeat me. And on top of that, I’m being attacked by FIVE right-wing super PACs. **The only way we can fend off this flood of GOP spending is by keeping our own ads on the air** — fighting back against misleading attacks, making sure voters know what I’m fighting for in the Senate, and exposing my opponent’s extreme, out-of-touch views. But these ads aren’t cheap and we’re facing an unexpected slump in our online fundraising, which means we have a pretty significant gap to fill in our campaign budget. So I’m counting on this team to help us get back on track. **[Can you pitch in today to support our campaign and help us keep our ads on the air?](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-jun24.Hijekx&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240611_PM2_V1_S1&t=5&akid=2797%2E35263%2ErGg7T8)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [CHIP IN $5 NOW](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/3663?c0=tbe-em-jun24.xQpXoA&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240611_PM2_V1_S1&t=6&akid=2797%2E35263%2ErGg7T8)

# Melton for Iowa 2024
---
---
| Hello Peter,

This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc.
Where I went on the campaign trail last week:
Last week, I attended the campaign kick off of Marshalltown city council candidate Melisa Fonseca, walked in the Flagfest parade in Spencer and tossed candy to the kiddos (and didn't run out before the end of the route, thank goodness), and attended journalist and author Robert Leonard's presentation in Algona. I also drove to a lot of different counties dropping off my yard signs.
The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: Definitely, the delivery of my yard signs took up most of my week last week. I put a lot of miles on the van dropping off signs to my various county sign handling volunteers. So, first off, if you live in the 4th congressional district here in Iowa and want a sign, let me know and I'll connect you with your county's point of contact for Melton signs. Let's get those signs out as soon as we can. I'd appreciate you planting one in your yard!
Beyond that, while doing sign deliveries in small town after small town, I saw a common thread run through each of those towns, and that was the pride people have in their public schools. There were signs in front yards and on town buildings showing that pride. Now, in most of these towns in our district, populations have been declining for quite some time, and the public school is often the #1 employer in these small towns.
Even the reddest of Republicans there know if they lose their school, they are very likely to lose their town. The brazen attacks on public ed, on the AEA system, and the consistent underfunding of those schools to do things like funding private schools with our public dollars, are really putting small town Iowa in peril. Just today, in fact, a school district in Adair county, just outside my district in Iowa, voted to end itself due to lack of population, staff, and funding (link below).
I'm a big believer in public education. I'm a graduate of public schools. Yes, as a federal candidate, I wouldn't deal directly with the funding of Iowa's schools, but public schools still do receive federal funding in various ways. Considering public education in red states is under unprecedented attack, I would do everything in my power from a federal level to make up for such harm coming from state-level officials.
Our schedule for this week: On Monday 6/10, I spoke with the Sioux City branch of the IBEW union. Tonight, 6/11, I delivered signs to my Boone and Story county contacts and did some sign planting and door knocking in Nevada. The rest of the week, I've got endorsement applications to fill out and volunteers to coordinate. On Saturday 6/15, I'll be walking with the Plymouth County Democrats in the Ice Cream Days parade in Le Mars in the morning, and will then drive down to Des Moines to catch the tail end of the State Party Convention, where I will be speaking. Sunday 6/16, it'll probably be light with it being Fathers' Day and my Father in Law being in town from Tennessee, but if I can break away, it'd be to deliver more signs. I have about 8 counties I still need to deliver to.
Recent press/social media posts of note: https://www.kcci.com/article/orient-macksburg-school-district-dissolving-uncertain-future-for-students/61076019
We again are rejecting all Corporate PAC money, so we really rely on, and are extremely grateful for your support. We'll spend your donations on ways to expand our reach to as many voters as possible, including: -Post cards and other mailers and postage -Hand out cards for events -Text messaging campaigns -Transportation costs for events and door knocking -Campaign website costs -Radio ads, Social Media Ads, and (hopefully) TV ads -Our campaign staffers
Finally, if you have anyone else in mind that would like to be added to our email list or who would be interested in volunteering, let us know at melton4iowa@gmail.com!
Let's keep fighting the good fight together! Ryan Melton

clean_body: | | | | == | == | Melton for Iowa 2024 | Hello Peter, This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc. Where I went on the campaign trail last week: Last week, I attended the campaign kick off of Marshalltown city council candidate Melisa Fonseca, walked in the Flagfest parade in Spencer and tossed candy to the kiddos (and didn't run out before the end of the route, thank goodness), and attended journalist and author Robert Leonard's presentation in Algona. I also drove to a lot of different counties dropping off my yard signs. The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: Definitely, the delivery of my yard signs took up most of my week last week. I put a lot of miles on the van dropping off signs to my various county sign handling volunteers. So, first off, if you live in the 4th congressional district here in Iowa and want a sign, let me know and I'll connect you with your county's point of contact for Melton signs. Let's get those signs out as soon as we can. I'd appreciate you planting one in your yard! Beyond that, while doing sign deliveries in small town after small town, I saw a common thread run through each of those towns, and that was the pride people have in their public schools. There were signs in front yards and on town buildings showing that pride. Now, in most of these towns in our district, populations have been declining for quite some time, and the public school is often the #1 employer in these small towns. Even the reddest of Republicans there know if they lose their school, they are very likely to lose their town. The brazen attacks on public ed, on the AEA system, and the consistent underfunding of those schools to do things like funding private schools with our public dollars, are really putting small town Iowa in peril. Just today, in fact, a school district in Adair county, just outside my district in Iowa, voted to end itself due to lack of population, staff, and funding (link below). I'm a big believer in public education. I'm a graduate of public schools. Yes, as a federal candidate, I wouldn't deal directly with the funding of Iowa's schools, but public schools still do receive federal funding in various ways. Considering public education in red states is under unprecedented attack, I would do everything in my power from a federal level to make up for such harm coming from state-level officials. Our schedule for this week: On Monday 6/10, I spoke with the Sioux City branch of the IBEW union. Tonight, 6/11, I delivered signs to my Boone and Story county contacts and did some sign planting and door knocking in Nevada. The rest of the week, I've got endorsement applications to fill out and volunteers to coordinate. On Saturday 6/15, I'll be walking with the Plymouth County Democrats in the Ice Cream Days parade in Le Mars in the morning, and will then drive down to Des Moines to catch the tail end of the State Party Convention, where I will be speaking. Sunday 6/16, it'll probably be light with it being Fathers' Day and my Father in Law being in town from Tennessee, but if I can break away, it'd be to deliver more signs. I have about 8 counties I still need to deliver to. Recent press/social media posts of note: We again are rejecting all Corporate PAC money, so we really rely on, and are extremely grateful for your support. We'll spend your donations on ways to expand our reach to as many voters as possible, including: -Post cards and other mailers and postage -Hand out cards for events -Text messaging campaigns -Transportation costs for events and door knocking -Campaign website costs -Radio ads, Social Media Ads, and (hopefully) TV ads -Our campaign staffers Finally, if you have anyone else in mind that would like to be added to our email list or who would be interested in volunteering, let us know at melton4iowa@gmail.com! Let's keep fighting the good fight together! Ryan Melton == | | | | | | | | == | == == == | == | P.O. Box 132 Nevada, IA 50201 melton4iowa@gmail.com | mailto:melton4iowa@gmail.com | | | | Political Campaign | PO BOX 132 | NEVADA, IA 50201 US | | | | | |

name: Lucas Kunce
subject: Awaiting the mifepristone decision
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
A quick refresher on Josh Hawley’s corrupt ties to one of the most anticipated Supreme Court decisions this year
#
Peter — sometime this month, the United States Supreme Court will announce their decision in the mifepristone lawsuit. That decision will determine if mifepristone, the most commonly used abortion pill, will remain legal in all 50 states.
**This radical out-of-touch case was first ruled on by a campaign donor Josh Hawley made a federal judge (and picked to oversee the case through “judge shopping”). It was led by Josh Hawley’s wife. And it’s even been directly supported by Josh Hawley’s taxpayer-funded role as U.S. Senator.**
It’s all part of Josh Hawley’s corrupt family business — his control-obsessed crusade to outlaw reproductive healthcare nationwide and strip away the fundamental right for everyday people to make decisions about their own bodies, families, and lives.
**Please let me explain.**
**[FIGHT BACK NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52128?refcode=em20240611-5740&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5740%2E614464%2EWwuz0U)**
The Hawley family business has been working toward this moment since 2019, when Josh Hawley was sworn into the Senate and confirmed his campaign donor, Matthew Kacsmaryk, to be a federal judge in the Northern District of Texas — despite bipartisan opposition over his bizarre obsession with controlling other people’s bodies.
Alliance Defending Freedom, the organization where Josh Hawley’s wife works as lead counsel, knew that Kacsmaryk shared their extreme views on abortion and reproductive rights. So when they filed a lawsuit, led by Josh Hawley’s wife, that aimed to restrict access to the abortion pill in all 50 states, they picked Matthew Kacsmaryk in the Northern District of Texas to be their judge.
It came as no surprise that Kacsmaryk – Josh Hawley’s donor and judge – ignored guidance from the FDA and reproductive health experts across the country to rule in favor of the suit led by Hawley’s wife.
Hawley later used his Senate office to file an amicus brief defending the ruling.
The sequence of events is one of the clearest examples of this kind of corruption to date. **Since the ruling, federal courts have even announced a new policy to prevent this kind of “judge shopping.”**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52128?refcode=em20240611-5740&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5740%2E614464%2EWwuz0U)
**[FIGHT BACK NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52128?refcode=em20240611-5740&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5740%2E614464%2EWwuz0U)**
**This is what we’re up against in Missouri this year, Peter.**
Control-obsessed elites like Josh Hawley are willing to do whatever it takes to strip away the essential freedom for everyday people to decide if and how they can build and raise their families.
Their first step was overturning Roe v. Wade. Now they’re attacking reproductive rights across the spectrum — from enacting Missouri’s exceptionless abortion ban, to outlawing the abortion pill across the country, and now restricting access to IVF.
**This election is our one and only opportunity to hold Josh Hawley accountable, and we can’t afford to waste it.[So Peter, will you help us get this message in front of Missouri voters by rushing a donation of $10 or whatever you can afford to my grassroots campaign today?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52128?refcode=em20240611-5740&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=5740%2E614464%2EWwuz0U)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52129?refcode=em20240611-5740&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=5&akid=5740%2E614464%2EWwuz0U) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52129?refcode=em20240611-5740&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=6&akid=5740%2E614464%2EWwuz0U) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52129?refcode=em20240611-5740&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=7&akid=5740%2E614464%2EWwuz0U) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52129?refcode=em20240611-5740&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=8&akid=5740%2E614464%2EWwuz0U) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52129?refcode=em20240611-5740&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=9&akid=5740%2E614464%2EWwuz0U) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52129?refcode=em20240611-5740&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=10&akid=5740%2E614464%2EWwuz0U) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52128?refcode=em20240611-5740&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=11&akid=5740%2E614464%2EWwuz0U)

I hope I can count on your support this year, Peter.

Lucas Kunce

### Friend --
### The emergency press conference being held by the Schiller Institute this Wednesday, June 12th, from 1 to 3 pm EDT, which will feature Scott Ritter, Ray McGovern, Helga LaRouche, and Col. Richard Black, is of particular importance! I urge you to join the meeting. Here are the links for the live-stream:
### **GENERAL PUBLIC: The public in general can view the online** here: [https://schillerinstitute.com/blog/2024/06/07/emergency-press-conference-the-danger-of-nuclear-war-is-real/](https://www.sareforsenate.com/r?u=rWeo0T8catXg17FnJdKclch4rT0zUMzIbv8-ZTeO_VuXGdKmOP7_2OXytq7A9UX4d5VioeGsKtE-QDmyMVDeQXewSj0YUgtSXoSWzHqGmXy6Hu6OLg-Pljfox201aZ5Jmun19ubjV9_HFbVpc8eIDw&e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=sare_invites_all_to_watch_the&n=2)
### **ONLINE JOURNALISTS PARTICIPATION:** Journalists wishing to participate on-line, please send an email to [questions@schillerinstitute.org](mailto:questions@schillerinstitute.org) indicating your name, media you represent, and language preference (English, German, French and Spanish can be accommodated), and you will receive a link by email.
### Here is the Schiller Institute's invitation:
| |
## Wednesday, June 12, 2024; 1:00—3:00 p.m. ET
________________________________
### National Press Club, Washington, D.C.;
### and on-line at Schillerinstitute.com
_______________________________
### **Scott Ritter** :
### Former U.N. weapons inspector and U.S. Marine intelligence officer
### **Col. (ret.) Richard H. Black** :
### Former head of the U.S. Army’s Criminal Law Division at the Pentagon; former State Senator, Virginia (Speaker’s views are not those of DOD or its agencies)
### **Ray McGovern** :
### Former CIA analyst and co-founder of the Veteran Intelligence Professionals for Sanity (VIPS)
### **Helga Zepp-LaRouche** :
### Founder of the Schiller Institute
\-----------------------------------------------------------
---
---
|
### On June 3, the U.S. State Department prevented U.S. citizen Scott Ritter from boarding his flight to St. Petersburg, Russia, and seized his passport. Ritter, a former U.S. Marine officer and United Nations weapons inspector who has become a prominent opponent of the current war policy, was traveling to participate in the St. Petersburg International Economic Forum (SPIEF), which was attended by an estimated 19,000 people and 3,400 media representatives from some 130 countries. Ritter was subsequently able to participate in the SPIEF panel via Zoom.
### In addition to the clear First and Fourth Amendment Constitutional issues raised by the Ritter case, the content of what Ritter was going to discuss is key: the need to improve U.S.-Russian relations and stop the escalating danger arising from NATO’s current posture towards Russia, as seen most starkly in Ukraine, which is dragging the world towards a nuclear World War III.
### The May 22 attack on a critical Russian early-warning radar system at Armavir, purportedly by “Ukrainian” drones, could have been the event which tipped the balance towards war—because it could have confirmed for Russia their stated belief that NATO and the West are intent on “blinding” Russia’s early-warning system in preparation for a possible “preemptive decapitation” strike by the U.S. and NATO against them. Russian President Vladimir Putin has repeatedly stated exactly this concern, publically, and it is the height of arrogant foolishness of the West to dismiss this as a “bluff,” as so many in Washington, London and other NATO capitals are now doing.
### As dangerous as attempting to blind Russia’s early-warning radar, are the efforts to silence opposition voices who function as a kind of “early-warning” system in the domain of policy deliberation—those who are warning of the danger of nuclear war, and are presenting alternatives to a policy of confrontation.
### On Wednesday, June 12 at the National Press Club in Washington, D.C., a distinguished panel of four experts will each make brief presentations on these topics, and will respond to questions from the media, both in person and over an international Zoom link (with simultaneous interpretation into German, French and Spanish for audiences in those countries).
### ______________________________________________________
### Recent comments by the panelists:
### **Scott Ritter:**
### “The command centers that Russia uses were conceptualized and constructed during the Soviet Union, when Ukraine was part of the Union, and, from a Russian perspective, they were deep in the Russian rear, protected. But if Ukraine now is carved out and made part of NATO, and you insert American missiles there, all of these places that were thought to be safe in the rear are now reachable. And if America allows Ukraine to use ATACMS missiles to strike these facilities, Russia will nuke NATO! Not Ukraine—NATO!... The Ukrainians are complaining that the United States will only allow them to use the HIMARS, that they won’t be allowed to use the ATACMS to strike Russia yet. But, just so everybody in your audience understands, we are one ATACMS launch away from everybody dying. The Russians aren’t playing games here.” [June 4, 2024, on Judge Andrew Napolitano’s “Judging Freedom” show]
__________________________
### **Senator Richard Black:**
### “Now, if you look at where we are right now with the three drone attacks directed at their eyes and ears against nuclear attacks, this clearly would trigger the nuclear doctrine of the Russian state. Now, in addition, if there’s actually a cohesive movement towards preparation for nuclear war—I’m not saying that we have made some sort of a decision, but we certainly are laying all the groundwork in case a decision was to be made. We’re attacking their early warning systems by blinding them. We have significant drone attacks against the nuclear bomber base in Russia, deep within Russia. Keep in mind that, from the Russian perspective, if you put yourself in their shoes, what do they see? They see that Russia is being blinded to where it can’t detect incoming attacks. Also, its nuclear bomber fleet is being attacked, repeatedly attacked. Now we see NATO moving nuclear capable F-16 jets into the country. You put all those together, and it is a very nerve-wracking situation for Russia, where they have such a short period between a nuclear launch against them and a decision being made to counter that launch. What do they do? How do they respond?” [May 30, 2024, interview with Executive Intelligence Review (EIR)]
____________________________
### **Ray McGovern:**
### “Russia views the U.S./NATO proxy war in Ukraine as the kind of existential threat that President John Kennedy perceived, when Moscow installed nuclear missiles in Cuba. Those missiles were capable of hitting, within minutes—Washington, D.C. and the Strategic Air Command in Omaha. For readers who have missed this, U.S. missile capsules already emplaced in Romania and Poland (ostensibly for ‘ABMs’) can accommodate overnight what Russia calls ‘offensive strike missiles’—with even shorter launch-to-target time—than those Kennedy strong-armed Khrushchev to remove from Cuba, under threat of nuclear war.” [Dec. 12, 2022, Antiwar.com]
____________________________
### **Helga Zepp-LaRouche:**
### “I can only say that the judgment of Scott Ritter is that once they start to use the ATACMS missiles, which have a much longer-range and could actually reach deep into Russian territory; or if German Chancellor Scholz capitulates again, which he is doing, and allows the Taurus cruise missiles to be deployed [to Ukraine], that could lead to the absolute destruction of Moscow, of the Kremlin, and would mean a guaranteed World War III. And we are absolutely sitting on that powder keg. Therefore, one ATACMS away from Armageddon is exactly where we are. And we have to really get the population mobilized... We have to convince the people of Western Europe and the United States that the countries of the Global South are not their enemy. What the BRICS-Plus countries are attempting to do is to straighten out the world order... [It is] eminently possible to establish a new security and development architecture.” [June 5, 2024, Weekly Schiller Institute webcast]

clean_body: | | Friend -- The emergency press conference being held by the Schiller Institute this Wednesday, June 12th, from 1 to 3 pm EDT, which will feature Scott Ritter, Ray McGovern, Helga LaRouche, and Col. Richard Black, is of particular importance! I urge you to join the meeting. Here are the links for the live-stream: GENERAL PUBLIC: The public in general can view the online here: ONLINE JOURNALISTS PARTICIPATION: Journalists wishing to participate on-line, please send an email to mailto:questions@schillerinstitute.org indicating your name, media you represent, and language preference (English, German, French and Spanish can be accommodated), and you will receive a link by email. Here is the Schiller Institute's invitation: | | Wednesday, June 12, 2024; 1:00—3:00 p.m. ET National Press Club, Washington, D.C.; and on-line at Schillerinstitute.com Scott Ritter : Former U.N. weapons inspector and U.S. Marine intelligence officer Col. (ret.) Richard H. Black : Former head of the U.S. Army’s Criminal Law Division at the Pentagon; former State Senator, Virginia (Speaker’s views are not those of DOD or its agencies) Ray McGovern : Former CIA analyst and co-founder of the Veteran Intelligence Professionals for Sanity (VIPS) Helga Zepp-LaRouche : Founder of the Schiller Institute \----------------------------------------------------------- | On June 3, the U.S. State Department prevented U.S. citizen Scott Ritter from boarding his flight to St. Petersburg, Russia, and seized his passport. Ritter, a former U.S. Marine officer and United Nations weapons inspector who has become a prominent opponent of the current war policy, was traveling to participate in the St. Petersburg International Economic Forum (SPIEF), which was attended by an estimated 19,000 people and 3,400 media representatives from some 130 countries. Ritter was subsequently able to participate in the SPIEF panel via Zoom. In addition to the clear First and Fourth Amendment Constitutional issues raised by the Ritter case, the content of what Ritter was going to discuss is key: the need to improve U.S.-Russian relations and stop the escalating danger arising from NATO’s current posture towards Russia, as seen most starkly in Ukraine, which is dragging the world towards a nuclear World War III. The May 22 attack on a critical Russian early-warning radar system at Armavir, purportedly by “Ukrainian” drones, could have been the event which tipped the balance towards war—because it could have confirmed for Russia their stated belief that NATO and the West are intent on “blinding” Russia’s early-warning system in preparation for a possible “preemptive decapitation” strike by the U.S. and NATO against them. Russian President Vladimir Putin has repeatedly stated exactly this concern, publically, and it is the height of arrogant foolishness of the West to dismiss this as a “bluff,” as so many in Washington, London and other NATO capitals are now doing. As dangerous as attempting to blind Russia’s early-warning radar, are the efforts to silence opposition voices who function as a kind of “early-warning” system in the domain of policy deliberation—those who are warning of the danger of nuclear war, and are presenting alternatives to a policy of confrontation. On Wednesday, June 12 at the National Press Club in Washington, D.C., a distinguished panel of four experts will each make brief presentations on these topics, and will respond to questions from the media, both in person and over an international Zoom link (with simultaneous interpretation into German, French and Spanish for audiences in those countries). Recent comments by the panelists: Scott Ritter: “The command centers that Russia uses were conceptualized and constructed during the Soviet Union, when Ukraine was part of the Union, and, from a Russian perspective, they were deep in the Russian rear, protected. But if Ukraine now is carved out and made part of NATO, and you insert American missiles there, all of these places that were thought to be safe in the rear are now reachable. And if America allows Ukraine to use ATACMS missiles to strike these facilities, Russia will nuke NATO! Not Ukraine—NATO!... The Ukrainians are complaining that the United States will only allow them to use the HIMARS, that they won’t be allowed to use the ATACMS to strike Russia yet. But, just so everybody in your audience understands, we are one ATACMS launch away from everybody dying. The Russians aren’t playing games here.” [June 4, 2024, on Judge Andrew Napolitano’s “Judging Freedom” show] Senator Richard Black: “Now, if you look at where we are right now with the three drone attacks directed at their eyes and ears against nuclear attacks, this clearly would trigger the nuclear doctrine of the Russian state. Now, in addition, if there’s actually a cohesive movement towards preparation for nuclear war—I’m not saying that we have made some sort of a decision, but we certainly are laying all the groundwork in case a decision was to be made. We’re attacking their early warning systems by blinding them. We have significant drone attacks against the nuclear bomber base in Russia, deep within Russia. Keep in mind that, from the Russian perspective, if you put yourself in their shoes, what do they see? They see that Russia is being blinded to where it can’t detect incoming attacks. Also, its nuclear bomber fleet is being attacked, repeatedly attacked. Now we see NATO moving nuclear capable F-16 jets into the country. You put all those together, and it is a very nerve-wracking situation for Russia, where they have such a short period between a nuclear launch against them and a decision being made to counter that launch. What do they do? How do they respond?” [May 30, 2024, interview with Executive Intelligence Review (EIR)] Ray McGovern: “Russia views the U.S./NATO proxy war in Ukraine as the kind of existential threat that President John Kennedy perceived, when Moscow installed nuclear missiles in Cuba. Those missiles were capable of hitting, within minutes—Washington, D.C. and the Strategic Air Command in Omaha. For readers who have missed this, U.S. missile capsules already emplaced in Romania and Poland (ostensibly for ‘ABMs’) can accommodate overnight what Russia calls ‘offensive strike missiles’—with even shorter launch-to-target time—than those Kennedy strong-armed Khrushchev to remove from Cuba, under threat of nuclear war.” [Dec. 12, 2022, Antiwar.com] Helga Zepp-LaRouche: “I can only say that the judgment of Scott Ritter is that once they start to use the ATACMS missiles, which have a much longer-range and could actually reach deep into Russian territory; or if German Chancellor Scholz capitulates again, which he is doing, and allows the Taurus cruise missiles to be deployed [to Ukraine], that could lead to the absolute destruction of Moscow, of the Kremlin, and would mean a guaranteed World War III. And we are absolutely sitting on that powder keg. Therefore, one ATACMS away from Armageddon is exactly where we are. And we have to really get the population mobilized... We have to convince the people of Western Europe and the United States that the countries of the Global South are not their enemy. What the BRICS-Plus countries are attempting to do is to straighten out the world order... [It is] eminently possible to establish a new security and development architecture.” [June 5, 2024, Weekly Schiller Institute webcast] Contact: Suzanne Klebe 201-220-7739, mailto:seklebe@yahoo.com \-- Diane * | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- | Paid for by Sare for Senate

subject: Help Danielle Johnson Fight Back Against DEQ's Actions
body:
Imagine a world where if you stand up against unfair treatment, you risk losing everything

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zuu2if3r9n5f1c392s5v8k3m3ol39c9lm0vasob8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30shge6ob2c1h2bs)

| |
Dear Friend of Liberty,

Imagine a world where if you stand up against unfair treatment, you risk losing everything--your dignity, your reputation, and even your job! Unfortunately, this is precisely what happened to Danielle Johnson at her workplace, Oregon's Department of Environmental Quality (DEQ).

DEQ wanted to institute "DEI" principles in hiring that would give preferences in hiring based on skin color. When Danielle raised valid concerns about the legality of these practices, DEQ retaliated against her.

**They slashed her paycheck, called her a racist in company-wide e-mails, demoted her, and dragged her through a baseless investigation.**

**It 's abhorrent, unconstitutional behavior. And if we allow this to continue, woke proponents of DEI will only grow stronger. **

**Danielle has stood up to fight back. We ask for anyone who supports her fight against DEI to sign this petition of support.**

[By signing this petition, you can send a clear message to DEQ and other organizations engaging in similar practices: discrimination against those who speak out is illegal.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zeafi15tji7peuubuputijg171erhnv6m3fh9uog_rp22sh2s8i6ep30shge6ob2c1h2bs)

Your signature is crucial in supporting Danielle's fight against unfair retaliation, and in defending the rights of individuals across the country. Without our intervention, any law-abiding citizen could be the next target.

Join us in supporting Danielle Johnson and defending free speech rights by signing the petition here: [https://mslegal.org/subscribe/johnson-petition/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zmb732sko1apkb5ljisevvnkmd947ba5q9k7ossg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30shge6ob2c1h2bs).

For Liberty!

Cristen Wohlgemuth

Mountain States Legal Foundation

name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: Before they're gone
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zc6h9096jgrdj3ekjv2jasv3mqjhkrcpcj3m63f0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30shge6pb6c1h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8lairrgjoht550kuqdc47epvr15ol1d2i1rn9u0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30shge6pb6c1h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zlv4rccua2ao14ovkaej95216va28r5ke49anfjg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30shge6pb6c1h2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College
P.S. The **“The Second World Wars”** DVD set is great as a homeschool curriculum or for independent study. Plus, it makes a perfect gift for anyone who wants to know more about the Second World War. **[Reserve your copy now.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvcpibbv1tg4juf8bqg4ovfurtul2pkeal7o49bg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30shge6pb6c1h2bs)**

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2ztehth0v5a3sht11u0qs67jldqmdr791tg62ljoo_rp22sh2s8i6ep30shie0o32c3h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zi6spi7nabfrnbop4jp737k4khpcjuksk68iq71o_rp22sh2s8i6ep30shie0o32c3h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z4i6pik75g9rvm0r3hg9tncgei1ab99iqvus9ra0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30shie0o32c3h2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!

## **Press Release:** Drew Johnson's Statement on Winning the Republican Nomination for Nevada's 3rd Congressional District
---
| June 11, 2024
---
| **Las Vegas, NV –** I’m honored to earn the trust and support of Republican primary voters in Nevada’s crucial 3rd Congressional District. The pundits didn’t give us a chance, but we outworked our opponents and overperformed expectations. I would like to thank, first and foremost, my wife, Sarah, for her unwavering support. She, along with my volunteers, donors, and campaign team, rose to the occasion to make this victory possible. I would also like to thank my primary challengers for the spirited campaigns they put forward over the past several months. I will work to unite our party behind our shared principles. Tonight, we celebrate our victory, but we know the real challenge is ahead of us in November’s general election. We will fight hard to earn the support of all voters throughout this district. We will expose how ethically bankrupt Susie Lee has failed Nevada by using her office to enrich herself and serving as a rubber stamp for the failed Biden administration. Right now, voters are struggling to make ends meet, worried about our country’s open borders, and fearful of crime in their own neighborhoods. I look forward to providing voters with a positive vision for cleaning up the mess Susie Lee and Joe Biden have created. -Drew Johnson, Republican nominee, NV-03

# WEDNESDAY, JUNE 12, 2024
---|---
**Good Morning**! On this date in 1987, [U.S. President Ronald Reagan](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuwyAURb8GNlvwAGMPDJUqL1UqZUo3C8MjpsUhcghW_r5y5673SufoXE7TycYUb9dPu6IpIU_WlVhx6hoODchJUm8CIqCgaLjmPR_UwDldDAjRc_SD7aVX0vnBYbCDdkqh8sppGg0wkKzjwHrV8a71Mrg-zEzPPgiNmkiGPpa8td853sqCIb1yxa11eaXJLKXcH0S8ERgJjPu-t6_8LM8Zj_9YbHELEWMl4v3yxdj5p34065luxt_3mFJ8dIfiutqY_pDl_8Bq4DcAAP__BQ9SoQ) delivered one of his most important Cold War era speeches and challenged Soviet Leader Mikhail Gorbachev to "tear down" the Berlin Wall. We want to give a tip of the hat today to Blue, a loyal dog who ran four miles through the wilderness to bring help for his owner, who had crashed his truck into a ravine. You can[ check out his story](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0D1uxCAQQOHT4G4sGPxbUKRxt2lTWrMwrEkwrDCxldtHmzr9Kz69j9t6oxBDerzTzqb6vJKt4eR1AIWA3do1znhmZN2wUaOa1NzPSjWbGTvL8s449db3yncavXQj6YF1r-cZm2BQYicHhXLqBzW0rvN28nc53p3XI4-ik-xCzaX9zCHVjX38ySeX1ua9iWar9XkI_SZwEbhc19WWTI6Sq4Xs1ysSuCS-DoELDUqOWvdS4OLyA2qhk-MBPn8X2EPkA2qGjeMT8pW4wFELJccOQoJCZ0gM5CsXsFTAFjo2gUtTjHteIcZwDC_tY6cQ_3T1_1enwd8AAAD__y78bSA) in today's edition. ## Hunter Biden Found Guilty in Gun Trial
Hunter Biden was [found guilty Tuesday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQgOGnMRsRHBiTgaGLt3TtaEE44osIRJg48ttX6dz5Hz79P5fl4ilTuX37B7qe6uKvnXZcDJfAQS-aRZcQARVDJydp5Xk8S8lW59MYRqUBjbWTVSIi4hikhWgwGqEYORCghZEg7GikOUWdrjYFMYWY1ITToAVG6rWd7pVKXzHlo-7YTtf6YNmtvT-3QX0NMA8w-2fB9_ZJA8yZdhxgXl-lY-OBIhZ-exXeG_nMoz848PurHTxipoDNd6plY83F55typs188NvDU_7D-v_ru4PfAAAA__8oCl0K) on three federal charges for lying about his drug use when purchasing a firearm in 2018. The jury in Delaware reached the verdict after a trial that included testimony about [Biden's struggles](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O6yAQRp_GdET8GeyC4jbuctstLQyDmRUxERlnlbdfJfXWnz6do_N1Xa8BKx77_3ADT7mtIRI-YbVcKq7MaljyGUCBZuClk5Ocx1lKVrzVAfQ0WuemaZ41jELLWdktBDmPMVqGXgllhJVKTKOV9pJMjlPehNtS1g7cYAQkpNYv3w0PKpDrqz2hX2K7seoL0f0x6H-DWga1UIGCtb63QS0d9rMGwnYMaont7MS3QFThMajFOGlGIXk5D4LON0xw8P3ESi-eIUEPle_nwWMJff88WPfp_oO14sO-tfZbwA-K0d9Rnl79BgAA__84WWSL) with substance abuse. President Joe Biden stated that [he would not pardon his son](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uwyAURp8Gb1hwjbEzMHTxlq4dLX4u4VYYR4TY6ttX7tz5k75zdL7u691SpvL4tBuaFvfV-kYHrppL4KBW1QUTEQGHDo2c5Cxv403KLhln7WinYKMaZuECjDgrwOE2xkmjdaIjAwKU0BLEPGqp-6Cin6MTkwtxmHBiSmCgttf-e6fSEsb8sx9Ye79vXTapteeLDR8MFgbLeZ69L85fI4PlumawCM1gkZLBkt6lYeWOAhbeKtnMD6yBfOMVrU8YOBX-eBfu7Qv71LbcVROeJ-VML33JPDZL-Q_e_k9xGPgNAAD__5agYLU), emphasizing the independence of the judicial process. name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: forgive me
body:
I had to share this heartbreaking story with you...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

I'm wiping away tears as I type out this story to you.

Our Northeast Field Operations Coordinator, Savannah Craven, recently told me about a young woman she met during our _Defund Planned Parenthood Display_ in Albany, NY.

She began to tell Savannah that she was in a detention center in the Bronx when she was young.

She recalled the staff bringing her to a _Planned Parenthood_ for an abortion and that it was the "most painful experience of [her] life."

After taking a Chemical Abortion Pill, _she saw her dead baby fall into the toilet_. A detention facility worker casually told her to just flush the baby down the toilet.

But she couldn't bring herself to do it.

What happened next will break your heart.

She shared that:
_**" I scooped the baby out of the toilet** and kept it in a box for years. It was only 10 or 11 weeks old, but it was a whole baby: **It was fully formed.** They lied to me."_
Even years later, this story brought tears to her eyes, and Savannah knew she still carried the deep hurt from this and other abortions this woman had.

Pro-Life Friend, _Planned Parenthood_ is taking advantage of vulnerable young women like this every day - and they're raking in massive amounts of our taxpayer dollars doing so!

**[Will you please click here to sign your DEFUND _PLANNED PARENTHOOD_ Petition right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gvdhx-duchtdja-y/)?**

During their last fiscal year, _Planned Parenthood_ admitted to committing at least 392,715 abortions all while U.S. taxpayers funded the Abortion Goliath to the tune of over $700 MILLION!

As you'll see, this petition simply urges your U.S. Representative and Senators do everything in their power to defund 100% of _Planned Parenthood 's_ taxpayer funding.

The truth is there's nothing politicians in BOTH parties HATE more than hearing from thousands of angry constituents in their districts - especially during critical election years like 2024.

But the truth is, election season is when politicians are on their "best behavior."

That means now is the perfect time to ramp up pressure on Congress to 100% DEFUND _Planned Parenthood_.

It's up to you and me to prove to them that if they cross the pro-life grassroots, they'll go down in flames in November.

So, will you do three favors for me?
**FIRST: Pray for the victims of abortion - _both mothers like the one I wrote you about above and their babies;_** **SECOND:[Sign your Defund _Planned Parenthood_ Petition](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gvdhx-duchtdja-j/); and** **THIRD:[Chip in to help us turn up the heat on politicians in BOTH parties before November](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gvdhx-duchtdja-i/).**
We need to make it clear that we don't want a cent of our tax dollars supporting such a bloody industry.

We can't let the Abortion Lobby have the final word on stories like this one.

Because we know that abortion does not solve "problems," it only creates more of them.

And mothers who have fallen for _Planned Parenthood 's_ lies need our support as they seek healing in their grief.

Let's ensure that our message of hope and healing drowns out the Abortion Goliath's violent agenda.

Countless mothers and babies are depending on it.

So, please sign your **[Defund _Planned Parenthood_ Petition](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gvdhx-duchtdja-d/)** right away **[and agree to your most generous contribution to help _Students for Life Action_ continue to help to young mothers and their babies](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gvdhx-duchtdja-h/).**

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/i4yV0NTZngR-mMBwdYchRQ~~/AARclAA~) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. body:
To view this email as a web page, click
https://view.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=07d77db7537237976d18aa2be72d6bc8e2fbd961a7ca9b8224093b7248b1561446bfe9f70865c6210abebf7af8c91d0dab9b1bd07e7d225fe0a591f2813e72c7fb748ba984e960aa5b8902af607e9d05
here.

Sturtevant: “Youngkin warned us about China’s Trojan horse. He was right.”

ICYMI: Senator Glen Sturtevant
https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=430f3bdff7572ae692018ac13add1400bf5df28e90446c775c60d70d3e948ad005bfaf5ef93f3093b1e741a5550a0360bc14e18a50c5edbe180be76b210ba215
penned an op-ed in the Richmond Times-Dispatch this week touting Governor Glenn Youngkin’s efforts to protect Virginians from potential threats from the Chinese Communist Party (CCP).

In the op-ed, Senator Sturtevant highlights Youngkin’s decision to halt a Chinese battery company from coming to Virginia,
https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=430f3bdff7572ae61a1804364f67db3e99dddd866f429aa776b0dabef724e04e3f02b3cd1224707b90af93a0080f506422336144310935d918a6f9a5f20d51c3
citing concerns it would serve as a “Trojan horse” for the CCP.

Youngkin’s decision was validated after Congress banned the Pentagon from purchasing batteries from that very same company.

https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=430f3bdff7572ae6765fc95e6863e2f33f961b942f98c44066ace124b814425fdbaa37ba5dbe5780bfc667154811f53dc76fa5d695bdd54fa40d92e2b33c900d
Bloomberg reported that “US lawmakers have banned the Defense Department from buying batteries produced by China’s biggest manufacturers, furthering efforts in Washington to decouple the Pentagon’s supply chain from its geopolitical rival. The rule implemented as part of the latest National Defense Authorization Act that passed on Dec. 22 will prevent procuring batteries from Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Ltd.”

As Senator Sturtevant writes in the op-ed, “when Gov. Youngkin decided to withdraw Virginia from being considered as the landing ground for the Ford-CATL factory, he did so with Virginia’s best interests and the United States’ national security in mind.”

https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=430f3bdff7572ae692018ac13add1400bf5df28e90446c775c60d70d3e948ad005bfaf5ef93f3093b1e741a5550a0360bc14e18a50c5edbe180be76b210ba215
Click here to read the full op-ed. Excerpts of the op-ed are included below.

https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=430f3bdff7572ae692018ac13add1400bf5df28e90446c775c60d70d3e948ad005bfaf5ef93f3093b1e741a5550a0360bc14e18a50c5edbe180be76b210ba215
Commentary: Youngkin warned us about China’s Trojan horse. He was right.

In January 2023, Virginia’s news media reported that Gov. Glenn Youngkin withdrew the commonwealth from being considered as the landing ground for a new CATL-Ford battery factory. CATL, also known as Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Limited, is a Chinese battery manufacturer that would have partnered with Ford to produce batteries for the F-150 Lightning series in Pittsylvania County. Following the announcement that Virginia had terminated negotiations with CATL, Youngkin’s decision was widely panned by Democratic legislators and political journalists.

…

When deciding to pull Virginia out of consideration for the CATL facility, Youngkin said, “the technology at the heart of this battery is from Chinese Communist Party-influenced CATL. ... (The project is) an economic arrangement engineered to tap into federal government subsidies paid for with taxpayer money that is going to economically benefit the Chinese Communist Party.”

At that time, Gov. Youngkin was sharply attacked by Democrats in the General Assembly and journalists.

…

Richmond Times-Dispatch political columnist Jeff Schapiro likened the Governor’s decision to “a fit of Sinophobia” and “an attempt to burnish his anti-communist credentials.”

Since Gov. Youngkin’s decision nearly a year-and-a-half ago, Ford stopped work on its CATL-partnered factory, which landed in Michigan with public subsidies amounting to nearly $700,000 per job created. Ford then renewed the plans, but with 800 fewer jobs and an average wage of less than $46,000. Congress also announced two separate, bipartisan investigations into Ford’s partnership with CATL, and Duke Energy disconnected CATL-produced batteries from Camp Lejeune over concerns of cybersecurity vulnerabilities from hackers associated with the Chinese government. Finally, in December 2023, Congress passed an amendment to the National Defense Authorization Act that prohibited the Defense Department from procuring CATL batteries, along with five other companies with concerning
Chinese Communist Party ties.

…

Had Youngkin’s critics taken the time to do their own research rather than giving knee-jerk criticism, it is likely they would have arrived at the same conclusion.

When Gov. Youngkin decided to withdraw Virginia from being considered as the landing ground for the Ford-CATL factory, he did so with Virginia’s best interests and the United States’ national security in mind. While it took some time for the truth behind CATL to become more widely known, it is reassuring to see the governor, Congress and the Biden administration on the same page regarding a corporate pawn of the Chinese Communist Party.

Youngkin decided to withdraw Virginia from being considered as the landing ground for the Ford-CATL factory, he did so with Virginia’s best interests and the United States’ national security in mind.” Click here to read the full op-ed. Excerpts of the op-ed are included below. Commentary: Youngkin warned us about China’s Trojan horse. He was right. In January 2023, Virginia’s news media reported that Gov. Glenn Youngkin withdrew the commonwealth from being considered as the landing ground for a new CATL-Ford battery factory. CATL, also known as Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Limited, is a Chinese battery manufacturer that would have partnered with Ford to produce batteries for the F-150 Lightning series in Pittsylvania County. Following the announcement that Virginia had terminated negotiations with CATL, Youngkin’s decision was widely panned by Democratic legislators and political journalists. … When deciding to pull Virginia out of consideration for the CATL facility, Youngkin said, “the technology at the heart of this battery is from Chinese Communist Party-influenced CATL. ... (The project is) an economic arrangement engineered to tap into federal government subsidies paid for with taxpayer money that is going to economically benefit the Chinese Communist Party.” At that time, Gov. Youngkin was sharply attacked by Democrats in the General Assembly and journalists. … Richmond Times-Dispatch political columnist Jeff Schapiro likened the Governor’s decision to “a fit of Sinophobia” and “an attempt to burnish his anti-communist credentials.” Since Gov. Youngkin’s decision nearly a year-and-a-half ago, Ford stopped work on its CATL-partnered factory, which landed in Michigan with public subsidies amounting to nearly $700,000 per job created. Ford then renewed the plans, but with 800 fewer jobs and an average wage of less than $46,000. Congress also announced two separate, bipartisan investigations into Ford’s partnership with CATL, and Duke Energy disconnected CATL-produced batteries from Camp Lejeune over concerns of cybersecurity vulnerabilities from hackers associated with the Chinese government. Finally, in December 2023, Congress passed an amendment to the National Defense Authorization Act that prohibited the Defense Department from procuring CATL batteries, along with five other companies with concerning Chinese Communist Party ties. … Had Youngkin’s critics taken the time to do their own research rather than giving knee-jerk criticism, it is likely they would have arrived at the same conclusion. When Gov. Youngkin decided to withdraw Virginia from being considered as the landing ground for the Ford-CATL factory, he did so with Virginia’s best interests and the United States’ national security in mind. While it took some time for the truth behind CATL to become more widely known, it is reassuring to see the governor, Congress and the Biden administration on the same page regarding a corporate pawn of the Chinese Communist Party. body:

# WE won the Primary!
---

Hello Peter, The emphasis is on "WE". I have so many to thank... First and foremost, I am deeply grateful to God. I felt His guiding hand and constant presence throughout this campaign. I heeded his son's words to 'Seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness...' Next, I want to thank Lesly, who has stood by me for over three years of campaigning. She wouldn't choose this for herself, but her love for me and our country inspires her to step outside her comfort zone. And to the hundreds of volunteers and thousands of supporters who voted for me: Your dedication and hard work have not gone unnoticed. Thank you for being the backbone of our true grassroots campaign. We were outspent by more than 500% by one competitor, but our team of dedicated, selfless women and men outworked all others. Your efforts have been instrumental in our victory. Thank you! Thank you! Thank you! I'm also grateful to the other Republican Candidates. Michael Boris, you ran a clean and honest campaign. Your integrity is commendable. Flemming Larsen, your hard work pushed me to work harder. You both have made me a better candidate, and I respect you for that. We must now come together to defeat Dina Titus. She has already begun her mud-slinging campaign against me. This morning, the DCCC sent out a post calling me extreme. Titus can't run on her dismal record, so she will resort to lies, innuendos, and deceit. How We Win the General In the 2022 election, Titus squeaked by with just 51.6% of the vote - the lowest percentage of all other Democrats who won Congressional elections in Nevada. We proved we can beat Titus. We beat Titus in Henderson. We beat Titus in Boulder City. We beat Titus by 20 points with in-person voters. Her very narrow victory was only because of Democrat ballot harvesting and mail-in voting. Like Ronald Reagan and Abraham Lincoln, who also lost their first elections, we will use the lessons learned in 2022 to win in 2024. Here's how...
* Republicans must embrace early voting, mail-in voting, and voter assistance. Until we can change the laws, we will use them to our advantage. Republican leaders, at all levels, are encouraging us to "bank our vote" by voting early.

* Personal contact with Republicans who didn't vote. Titus' margin of victory over me and the Libertarian candidate was just over 7,000 votes, yet 46,000 registered Republicans did not vote. We have their contact information and an army of volunteers to encourage them to vote in this year's general.

* Capitalize on our momentum. Democrats are not excited about a dazed and confused Joe Biden or his strongest supporter, Dina Titus. Republicans are excited and energized to retire Biden and expand our majority in Congress. We will capitalize on this enthusiasm and momentum by getting more people involved in our Get Out the Vote (GOTV) efforts.

* Expand our base. In 2022, we spent a lot of time in our Hispanic communities. A large percentage of the votes I received came from independent and non-partisan voters. We will double our outreach efforts to bring voters into our coalition.

The last election was the first time I've run for public office. Voters now know who I am. We will capitalize on the goodwill, name recognition, and lessons learned in 2022 to win in 2024.
Please reply to this email to join our Army of Volunteers to put America first and take back our country!

*******

Groundzero - BRIDGEPORT \- Where's Wanda? - Back in court, but this time charged with Election Fraud and Witness Tampering. On Tuesday, June 11th four Bridgeport officials were brought into court in Bridgeport to be charged with election fraud, "unlawfully possessing another person's absentee ballot." Three of them, including Wanda Geter-Pataky were charged with "tampering with a witness" as well. But this charging action is just the latest milestone in a years-long saga in the history of Bridgeport ballot tampering.
To bring the many election-tampering threads in the 4th District forward, let's review. While Wanda Geter may be the more infamous, she, city council member Alfredo Castillo, and Nilsa Heredia, all on team-Ganim in Bridgeport, were named in a criminal referral last June '23 for their actions in the 2019 Democrat mayoral primary. The charge was illegally collecting absentee ballots in violation of state law.
Then, with that 2019 ballot tampering criminal process still ongoing, Wanda was caught on surveillance video, stuffing ballots into an official Bridgeport drop box on multiple occasions. Because of the incriminating video, this episode received significant media coverage, including on national media. At a 10-13-23 court hearing, Wanda invoked the 5th Amendment 71 times under questioning. But Wanda was merely placed on paid administrative leave from the City of Bridgeport, a status she maintains yet today. She also remains today as DTC vice-chair - unbelievable! But the ballot tampering scandal is not limited to just this Bridgeport crew's exploits, there are others:

* In Stamford, the State Appellate Court on May 31st just Upheld the conviction of former Democrat Committee Chair John Mallozzi, on 14 counts of absentee ballot tampering.
* Former Bridgeport City Councilman Michael DiFilippo just pled guilty on May 6th to deprevation of civil rights resulting from his forging signatures and submitting fraudulent election documents during his run for city council.

And Jim Himes has been benefitting from it all for 16 years, and recently Endorsed the Bridgeport Machine. In a press release yesterday I stated:
"I call upon State Democratic Party Chairwoman DiNardo to rescind Wanda Geter's community service award, on Governor Lamont and my opponent Jim Himes to stop employing firms and political operatives who violate our election laws, City Council President Nieves to remove Castillo from all council committees, the Chief state's attorney and Justice Department to swiftly prosecute election fraud crimes, Mayor Joe Ganim to terminate Wanda's employment with the city, and I call upon the man who wields power over all elected city officials, Bridgeport party boss Mario Testa, to demand Wanda's resignation as DTC Vice-Chair."

NY-21 Updates on the Congressional Race
* * *
# [I'm not backing down. I'm doubling down. ](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2618261&post_id=145567926&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ1NTY3OTI2LCJpYXQiOjE3MTgxOTA4ODksImV4cCI6MTcyMDc4Mjg4OSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI2MTgyNjEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.A_ARm7M0Ef5_dsn3tyA6d2Yq-y9RpZQm00H41FmLF_U)
### Stay tuned.
| | [Paula Collins](https://substack.com/@paulaforcongress)
---
| Jun 12
---
| [](https://substack.com/@paulaforcongress)
---
---
| | | [](https://substack..9b3OUSulZBAVVmKxqAKWOTOpR0Z9wElWiEZjLjx1xrw?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/paulany21/p/im-not-backing-down-im-doubling-down?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store)
---
Follow the bouncing ball, and you'll see that Congresswoman Stefanik has been busy on everything from [praising the Hunter Biden verdict](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/025c961f-37f1-4395-94f7-abfddcc99f3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to [slamming the Trump verdict](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c62f63c3-6cf2-4b0b-815c-fa6a75737e0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Ya gotta love when she refers to the "Biden Crime Family".
Um. Do the math. Three felonies for holding a gun for a grand total of 11 days is still less than 34 felonies, a total of 91 indictments, and damages totaling $355 million in civil penalties. That figure is not inclusive of the several thousands of dollars paid in the hush money case for contempt charges on violations of the gag orders, nor the $25 million that the Trump organization had to pay in the Trump University law suit some years ago. Trump has enough guilty verdicts and indictments to go around for an entire Trump Crime Syndicate.
It is clear that Elise Stefanik is incapable of grasping the differences between the the legal status of presumptive Presidential nominee Donald Trump and adult son of President Biden. Of course Elise Stefanik cannot grasp these nuances - [she was never accepted into law school, though she applied to several schools. ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/fb7614fd-5c82-4188-8b99-f221d07563cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Speaking of schools, Stefanik is following up on her inquisition of elite university presidents and major school district leaders by ["rescuing military kids from lefty indoctrination in DOD schools." ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/2bb6433a-eca1-47d4-af64-cb63c8d44b15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
As she loves to say on her press releases, "ICYMI", Stefanik has no credentials as a professional educator. Despite her lengthy interrogations of well-established professional educators, Stefanik has no job credentials at all beyond a very basic undergrad degree. As such, Stefanik could not even get a classroom teacher job in a public school in New York. To be qualified to teach in New York state, an applicant needs at least a Master's degree, a period of student teaching, and passing marks on several standardized teacher-certification exams. A large number of New York certified educators have a Master's degree plus 30 hours of graduate-level eduction or more. Don't worry, we have excellent teachers' unions to help us navigate these requirements.
And unlike professional educators, or lawyers, or anyone in dozens of other professions, Stefanik is not required to do hours a year of continuing ed to maintain a credential. Maybe what we are seeing in recent months is resounding evidence that she has reached the full extent of how far her Harvard undergrad can get her.
There are times when you wish a strong case of imposter syndrome on someone. I guess the mask mandates and vaccines protected her from catching that particular virus.
This is your regular reminder that all of the press releases mentioned above, including frequent links to fake news sites such as Federalist.com, are on her taxpayer-provided House.gov account.
And please don't worry that Stefanik's lack of credentials will result in unemployment after she leaves Congress. She will simply take her [political punditry to the air waves on MAGA Media](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/5cc6ece9-9174-46e9-9bb6-91b16b73388d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). You can read all about it on her taxpayer-funded House.gov website.
Stefanik's team has been busy, floating fundraising emails referring to me as the "Far Left Liberal Democrat", or posting clips about me from Fox News on the platform formerly known as [Twitter, in which I am compared to none other than Hillary Clinton.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b09a79ae-e9ad-4b10-a267-90f683bee219?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I am verklempt. (Not a word used by an anti-semite, btw.)
It's summer time, and the Collins team is busy sending out packing lists for camp: Integrity, Ethics, Transparency, Principles.
Still waiting to hear back from the Alito Family on their ETA. They will find us. We fly the American flag properly and proudly at Camp Collins.
The Democrats, led by the Biden-Harris ticket, guaranteed overtime pay for an additional 3.6 million workers, the first-in-the-US-over-the-counter contraception, a stop to discriminatory mortgage lending, and the biggest infrastructure investment on record. I intend to join the Democrats in DC in 2025 as the U.S. Representative from NY's 21st Congressional District.
Stay tuned. I'm not backing down. I'm doubling down.

name: Aliscia Andrews for Congress
subject: Team Andrews Final Pre-Election Day Roundup
body:
Good afternoon,

Thank you again for reaching out to Team Andrews. Election Day is only 6
days away, and we're campaigning day in and day out to flip VA-10 red!
Aliscia has spent the last six months campaigning all over the district,
from Rappahannock County to Eastern Loudoun and everywhere in between, and
is extremely excited to secure the Republican Nomination in the VA-10
primary next Tuesday. A few additional things:

If you would like a yard sign delivered to your home, please respond to
this email with your address and a time so that a member of our team can
bring one by at your convenience, and we will deliver a yard sign right to
your doorstep.

Also, if you would like to doorknock this coming Saturday, or have
availability on Election Day to talk to voters at a polling location, you
can contact me directly at 832-687-1731, or respond to this email, and we
will set up a time to chat.

Thank you all so much for your time, energy and support, and we are looking
forward to seeing you on Election Day!

Thank you,

Will Funk
Campaign Manager
Andrews for Congress
