name: Prescott for Congress
subject: ADVISORY: Russell Prescott Officially Files for Congress
body:
| | | |
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: June 12, 2024
---
| Contact: Derek Dufresne derek@ascent-strategic.com; 202-809-6013
---
| Russell Prescott Officially Files for Congress
---
| Exeter, NH \- Russell Prescott, candidate for Congress in the First Congressional District of New Hampshire, will officially file with the Secretary of State this Thursday, June 13, at Noon. To date, Prescott has received nearly 200 endorsements from leaders across the district and has over a half million cash on hand.
What: Russell Prescott Officially Files for Congress
When: Thursday, June 13, at 12 PM
Where: New Hampshire Secretary of State Office
---
|
---
|
---
---
| More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce. He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business. | ### | == | | == == == | | | | Prescott for Congress | PO Box 26 | Kingston, NH 03848 US | | | | | |

---
Remember this? [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-june-elect-dems-2024?refcode=em240612&refcode2=146_22930333_YVhJ9S&akid=146%2E22930333%2EYVhJ9S) It's from the 2004 Republican National Convention where delegates and attendees wore Purple Heart band-aids to mock Senator John Kerry's service in Vietnam. Remember this person? [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-june-elect-dems-2024?refcode=em240612&refcode2=146_22930333_YVhJ9S&akid=146%2E22930333%2EYVhJ9S) That’s Democratic Senator Max Cleland -- a triple-amputee from wounds suffered on the battlefield in Vietnam. But that didn’t stop Republicans from attacking him in ads, asserting he was soft on terror after using pictures of Osama bin Laden and Saddam Hussein. Twenty years later, the attacks from Republicans on veterans haven't stopped -- they've only intensified. Marjorie Taylor Greene said enlisting is like “throwing your life away.” Republicans are united in privatizing veterans health care and trying to stop active duty women from taking leave to go to a state that provides abortion access. And of course, their standard bearer - Donald Trump says we "have a woke military that can’t fight or win" and called fallen soldiers “suckers and losers.” There are many stakes in this election, but here is one: Will we have a president who, in Joe Biden's words, understands the "sacred obligation to equip those we send to war and take care of them and their families when they come home or if they don’t come home.” Or will we have a president who thinks those who served are suckers and losers? I want to take a moment to remind you of my journey to the U.S. Senate, the important le ssons I have learned along the way, and why I continue to believe wholeheartedly in our beloved state.

My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty.

From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming.

Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving.

As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as _"Wyoming's doctor,"_ but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. I have wholeheartedly dedicated myself to serving the state, addressing its challenges, and making it the best it can be.

**_Whether it's advocating for our veterans, championing American energy security, or safeguarding our borders, I've always strived to be a voice for all Wyoming people. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations._**

As we look towards the future, I'm confident that Wyoming has the potential to be an even stronger, more prosperous state. **[But it will require strong leadership, a clear vision, and your continued support.](http://links.gopmembership.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=5585823f6f944680ad5514626673554d&_e=HWnCyePl9cgbItvQw1G2YV763FdF5iqIJWPfBYkIC0mmDck_G5J-l5sZ8lnppQEIUz8iAcWe2GWb3oPVGUsNmLh8QHgDTKQcQrtR2XN9jubIzA804YjQtK0UwSeqETVLMG-aJko-NbIEfA_UqPkur7c6v4PlUbVahBgsW54VwYfYqOYKdTfuUtaPvptKHmesw7XBKhjYU_OU5bsRpGpievuMEiM2HjwvREOxksKlu2JFba1vvAhVS9mV33DPhJdunuw7zHzu0zfUtuBxULLbyw%3D%3D)**

Already, your support has been instrumental in my journey, and I promise to continue fighting for the issues that matter most to Wyoming families.

Sincerely,
Senator John Barrasso [CHIP IN FOR A STRONG WYOMING](http://links.gopmembership.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=5585823f6f944680ad5514626673554d&_e=HWnCyePl9cgbItvQw1G2YV763FdF5iqIJWPfBYkIC0mmDck_G5J-l5sZ8lnppQEIUz8iAcWe2GWb3oPVGUsNmLh8QHgDTKQcQrtR2XN9jubIzA804YjQtK0UwSeqETVLowXjiKBm-Xg-uQr--D3h2doAsJ6-cWIynvsu8UGTQgOiGVHdMA-3Bi-6grLZvlI41LQnDcwInELWzkCA9cmz7NbURNm8Gpwe7Yy1UgHIukU_5Uf7tyPRfmqu-wwxB_CjGvInbeeSJza2849ogICAIA%3D%3D)

Antisemitism is bad. It is wrong. It is dehumanizing. Period.
There's no "but" after the above statements, and there's no debate about the evilness of antisemitism.
The purpose of this post is to understand the source of antisemitism in America, because the facts tell us a very different story than the media narrative. While several media reports in the previous few months sought to malign peaceful university students protesting the siege on Gaza as antisemitic, the truth historically and contemporarily demonstrates otherwise. Let's pull out the receipts.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=145557930&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ1NTU3OTMwLCJpYXQiOjE3MTgxOTc2MTksImV4cCI6MTcyMDc4OTYxOSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.PGFNmtHd2OHPtr4ShAeAn-7h7Vp2krjbsrxVA5sl_8E)
I looked up the ADL data on antisemitic hate crimes in America. The [ADL H.E.A.T. Map](https://substack.com/redirect/55ca9c8b-51b4-4c48-8e0e-cb6dfe98c840?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) data goes back to 2002. If you had to guess what percentage of antisemitic hate crimes were from Muslims vs Leftists vs Right over the past 22 years, what would you guess? Hold that thought.
Let's start with antisemitic hate crimes by Muslims or "Islamists" as the ADL calls them. Would you believe that since 2002, the ADL records exactly 0 antisemitic hate crimes by Muslims? ZERO.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bbc8eece-d90d-4f30-8805-fac3de81602a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
So what about leftists? Well, you might be surprised once more.
According to the ADL, since 2002, leftists have been responsible for a whopping...0 antisemitic hate crimes. ZERO.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/27e52b6e-cdbf-40a9-8d56-29400beae0d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
So to keep count. Zero antisemitic hate crimes from Muslims. Zero antisemitic hate crimes from leftists. What percent then, shall we guess, does the Right account for in antisemitic hate crimes since 2002?
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..QsEvcJ8tEPZ0f_dg1OB9k9dcZs_gwVVQK28z0zHJCRU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145557930)
According to the ADL, since 2002, the Right has been responsible for an incredible, a horrifying, a sickening 100% of antisemitic hate crimes--totaling at least 3058 antisemitic hate crimes. And it's getting worse.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0180d0de-6a57-4d0e-b44d-8d997971c291?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
So to quickly recap--per ADL, perpetrators of antisemitic hate crimes in the United States of America since 2002 are:
* 0% Muslim
* 0% Leftist
* 100% Right Wing

Would you have known that following the media narrative demonizing Muslims and the politically left leaning college students and organizations?
As we watch an interfaith cohort of university students--Jewish, Muslim, Christian, Sikh, people of no faith and every faith--stand united for justice for Palestine, it is critical we ensure antisemitic provocateurs do not detract from their efforts for justice. It is critical we stand united--Muslims, Jews, Christians, Sikhs, people of all faith & no faith--against all antisemitism, Islamophobia, & xenophobia. Indeed, it is powerful to watch [Jewish students at Columbia](https://substack.com/redirect/6af5d0fd-f609-4596-acca-31b0f0b34411?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) lead the charge and condemn the weaponization of antisemitism against their efforts to promote peace and justice.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=145557930&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ1NTU3OTMwLCJpYXQiOjE3MTgxOTc2MTksImV4cCI6MTcyMDc4OTYxOSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.PGFNmtHd2OHPtr4ShAeAn-7h7Vp2krjbsrxVA5sl_8E)
If we do not stand united against hate, we risk allowing right wing extremists to drive both the media narrative, and also the policy narrative. That will harm Jews, Muslims, and every minority group in America. We must uphold justice above all else. That is the path to peace.

By Illinois Review
Vince Kolber, chairman of the Illinois Republican Party Finance Committee abruptly resigned on Tuesday in an angry letter to IL GOP chairman Don Tracy, just weeks after the influential conservative grassroots base of the Illinois Republican Party scored major victories during the GOP State Convention in Collinsville – and after two years of unflattering stories by this publication.

Kolber, who is registered to vote in Illinois and Wisconsin, is still angry about losing his election at the state convention for national committeeman – after being eliminated in the first round to Mark Shaw, who faked a delegate badge and threatened to beat up a fellow state central committee member. During the first day of the convention, the Republican National Committeeman Nominating Committee voted 14-3 (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/il-gop-bylaws-ignored-to-allow-vince-kolber-to-remain-a-national-committeeman-candidate-despite-failing-to-meet-requirements-during-gop-state-convention.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=1ebe01c5b1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) to keep Kolber on the ballot despite failing to meet the candidacy requirements as outlined by the IL GOP’s own bylaws.

Friends,
The lead paragraph from a local news outlet succinctly explains what happened in last night's GOP primaries in South Carolina:
> "Targeted by a seven-figure smear campaign orchestrated by South Carolina's uniparty leaders and their special interest allies, the Palmetto State's nascent **Freedom Caucus** not only survived the onslaught - it managed to take out several pro-establishment incumbents and add to its ranks."
That's right. ALL South Carolina Freedom Caucus members who ran for re-election won their races, despite over $2.3 million getting spent against them. SCFC heroes like April Cromer, RJ May, Josiah Magnuson, and Joe White all defeated their Uniparty opponents.
In addition, several new candidates - most of them recruited by the SC Freedom Caucus - won open seats and defeated liberal RINO incumbents.
Earlier this year, RINO State Rep. Jay West - **the Assistant Majority Leader** __ \- was caught on tape trying to get special interest groups to help fund their efforts to defeat the SC Freedom Caucus. He said, "Y'all need to help us get rid of them." Then he added, "We need more normal people to run [for office]."
**Well, RINO Jay West got destroyed in his own primary last night.** The voters sent him packing, 64% - 36%, in favor of conservative newcomer Lee Gilreath.
RINO State Rep. Bill Sandifer, a powerful committee chairman, lost his re-election to conservative Adam Duncan. The same goes for liberal State Rep. Jerry Carter. Gone.
All in all, the SC Freedom Caucus will be growing their ranks while the Columbia Swamp will be getting smaller!
Sadly, last night wasn't a complete success. The SC Freedom Caucus's wonderful chairman, Adam Morgan, lost his bid for Congress in a tight race, 48% to 52%. And his amazing SCFC colleague, Stewart Jones, lost his race for Congress as well. Both men contributed greatly to helping launch the SC Freedom Caucus and making it grow. Morgan, especially, has done a remarkable job leading the SCFC, giving conservatives in South Carolina a loud voice in the Columbia Swamp. When the SC Freedom Caucus eventually succeeds in remaking the Palmetto State into a shining example of freedom and limited government, it will be in no small part because of his remarkable leadership.
**Going forward, there are just 3 primaries left for our State Freedom Caucuses** \- Arizona on July 30, Missouri on August 6, and Wyoming on August 20.
If our Freedom Caucus revolution is going to complete the FULL SWEEP in this election year, we need your help! Please donate to the State Freedom Caucus Network NOW so that we can expand and grow into all 50 states! We have a country to save and it begins and ends with strong, principled State Freedom Caucuses. Don't hesitate. Donate today!
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/82388d24-c28b-45c0-89d2-f5982e0f30e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Keep fighting,
**Andy Roth**
_President
State Freedom Caucus Network_
P.S. Your help is critical in building out a network of patriots and freedom fighters throughout our nation's state capitols and in your home state. Please consider a [contribution](https://substack.com/redirect/74ee81ba-8d96-44e2-9ebd-35ae9113e79b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and join us as we work to advance the cause of liberty.

name: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell
subject: Pulse Nightclub
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Debbie for Florida
body:
I'm reaffirming my commitment to end the plague of gun violence in our state
| | |
---
Friend,

Eight years ago today, hundreds of innocent Floridians walked into Pulse nightclub expecting a night of joy, fun, and celebration for Pride Month.

But a mass shooter motivated by hate — someone who never should have been able to even secure a weapon — also entered Pulse nightclub, murdering 49 people and wounding 53 others. It remains one of the deadliest mass shootings in our nation's history — a terrible scar on our state, resulting in carnage that could have been prevented and emotional damage for survivors and loved ones alike.
As we remember Pulse, my heart goes out to the families and friends of those who were taken from us, to the survivors who lived through such horror, and especially to the LGBTQ+ and Latino communities in Orlando forever altered by what took place eight years ago today.

I know what it's like to lose someone to gun violence. It’s a terrible pain that I've carried with me since I was 24, and one that will stay with me forever. It's knowing this type of loss that pushed me into public service.
So let me say this as clearly as I can: It is long past time we take bold action to address gun violence. While progress has been made, we have a long way to go. In America right now, firearms are the No. 1 cause of death for children. It’s the greatest moral failing of our time. I refuse to sit by idly and let it continue. Everybody deserves to feel safe in their own community — at a nightclub, at church, in a store, at home, _everywhere._
In remembering and honoring those taken from us eight years ago today at Pulse — and in the midst of Gun Violence Awareness Month — I'm reaffirming my commitment to end the plague of gun violence in our state. My opponent, Rick Scott, has stood firmly in the way of legislation to prevent gun violence while being backed by the gun lobby throughout his career. I'm running to be Florida's next U.S. Senator to _expand_ gun safety laws so nobody has to live in fear. You have my word on that.
Today, my heart is with all those impacted by the loss of life at Pulse nightclub. Together, we can and _will_ do better — to deliver the change that's been urgently needed and make our communities safe for our loved ones.

In solidarity,

Debbie

# The Most Hated Man in the Senate
---
| [ ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/3magasenators?refcode=ad)
---
| Look, hating Ted Cruz has been a fixture of American politics for the past decade. Ever since his starring role in the 2013 government shutdown, Cruz proved himself as unafraid to challenge _petty_ things like **the rule of law** and **the continued functioning of government**. And though he won the minds of many Republicans, he hardly won their hearts. Hating Ted Cruz has been a much-needed source of bipartisanship in our legislature over the years. Matt Dowd, chief strategist for the Bush-Cheney campaign, stated that _**“to know Ted Cruz is to dislike Ted Cruz”**_ , while Al Franken said, _**“I like Cruz more than most, and I hate him.”**_ Cruz has embraced this “maverick” persona, paving the way for an entirely less civil mode of American politics. 2024 may be our best shot to unseat Cruz. **Texans have literally created an urban legend around his appearance at recent Astros baseball games, blaming his presence for the team’s bad performance, and begging the senator to stay home.** Recent polls have Cruz leading only by single digits. While there is a great satisfaction in thinking of Ted Cruz unseated, it also speaks to a worrying trend in the Republican party. _**The new generation of Ted Cruzes are so much better at being hated, at not caring whether they break our government. They have entirely dispensed with party loyalty in favor of petty one-upmanship.**_ The rot forming within the Republican party, which pushes outwards until it corrodes the very institutions it is meant to service, is incredibly dangerous at this fraught moment in global politics. The stakes for unseating Republican radicals has never been higher. # [Sign: Demand Justice Samuel Alito resign from the Supreme Court >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5bfda1e1-2e19-45f5-a210-e5567b2f82e0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2ba99540-b28c-49f4-b87d-60518c98f236/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | In a [secret audio recording](https://default.salsalabs.org/T502eb443-65d5-4188-b482-853e828d2b1c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) obtained by undercover journalist [Lauren Windsor](https://default.salsalabs.org/T47192d99-028a-45ab-a75b-15647232c2c0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), Justice Samuel Alito endorsed the idea of returning America to "a place of godliness" and apparently using his position to help do so, saying "one side or the other is going to win" in reference to a growing divide between Democrats and Republicans. Alito is supposed to base his rulings on the Constitution and the law, not his religious beliefs. [**America is not a theocracy – and Alito must resign.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7d7cb990-2c55-4830-8fcd-6451dc550029/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) This bombshell report comes just after Alito's wife came under fire for flying flags associated with efforts to overturn the 2020 election. How can Alito possibly be impartial, as Supreme Court justices are expected to be, when it comes to cases related to January 6, abortion, and more? We've been watching extremist right-wing justices chip away at our rights and infuse their own personal beliefs and biases in their rulings. Enough is enough. [**Join us in calling on Samuel Alito to RESIGN from the Supreme Court >>**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc05983ad-67aa-40de-bdf4-d01277a6efd4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

**[Hunter Biden found guilty on all counts by Delaware jury in gun trial](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE WASHINGTON TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
A federal jury [convicted Hunter Biden](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Tuesday of three felony counts stemming from the purchase of a gun in October 2018 while in the throes of a crack addiction, making him the [first child](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) of a sitting president to be convicted of a crime.
The panel of six men and six women, all Delaware residents, deliberated for three hours over two days before rendering the [guilty verdict](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) which could have political implications for President Biden. Republicans have sought to tie his son's legal problems to him in the midst of a tough reelection campaign against former President Donald Trump.
The defendant's wife Melissa and his uncle, James Biden, were in the courtroom when the verdict was announced. [First lady Jill Biden](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), who attended most of the weeklong trial, arrived at the courthouse after the verdict was read.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[What's on my ballot? There are two opposed races for the state board of education](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Two contested races for the [Colorado Board of Education](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) will appear on the primary ballots for Districts 2 and 8, requiring voters in those districts to choose among candidates.
* Coloradans can [register to vote](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) online at GoVoteColorado.gov by June 17 to receive a mail-in ballot, or they can register in person up until 7 p.m. on Election Day, June 25.
* The Colorado Board of Education elections are based on U.S. House districts, and currently, Democrats hold a [6-3 majority](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on the board.
* District 2's Democratic primary will feature Kathy Gebhardt and Marisol Lynda; however, there will be [no Republican candidate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on the ballot for this district.
* Other districts will also see candidates on the ballot: District 3 has Ellen Angeles for Democrats and Sherri M. Wright for Republicans, while District 4 has Krista Holtzmann for Democrats and Kristi Burton Brown and Saundra Larsen for Republicans.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Fort Collins to start 2-year, $42M infrastructure project in Old Town to address 150-year-old issues](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CBS COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Fort Collins is launching a [$42 million infrastructure project](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in Old Town to address longstanding flooding issues, with the initiative set to begin in July and expected to last two years.
* The project aims to install a [new drainage system](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) with pipes six-and-a-half feet wide, digging over 30 feet deep in some areas, designed to manage the "100-year flood" level. This extensive plan includes overhauling the drainage along Oak Street, west of College Avenue, an area that has experienced recurrent flooding since the 1800s.
* Recent studies indicate potential flood damage could [exceed $150 million](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), validating the project's cost-effectiveness.
* [Enhancements](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) from the project will also improve roadways and sidewalks, increase handicap accessibility, add more green spaces, and introduce new art installations throughout the community.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Campaign complaint dismissed against El Paso County commissioner running for state office](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO SPRINGS GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Colorado Secretary of State's office [dismissed a campaign complaint](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) against El Paso County Commissioner Stan VanderWerf, asserting that his campaign comments during a county meeting were within his free speech rights.
* [Integrity Matters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), the watchdog group that filed the complaint, argued VanderWerf inappropriately discussed his state Senate plans during a public meeting, but the state found no specific law was violated.
* VanderWerf defended his comments as legal, while Integrity Matters plans to [appeal the dismissal](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Separate complaints against another candidate, David Leinweber, are still pending, with a [decision expected soon](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Nearly $300K from group with hidden donors pours into Colorado Democratic primary](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* [Representation Matters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), an independent expenditure committee, has spent $271,000 on behalf of Idris Keith in the Democratic primary for Colorado Senate District 28 against state Rep. Mike Weissman.
* The spending is notable as it makes up about [20% of all outside spending](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on state legislative primaries in Colorado. The source of the funding for Representation Matters is obscured, with connections traced back to other committees and a super PAC, which [delays donor disclosure](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) until after the primary elections.
* Both Keith and Weissman have condemned the influx of large, untraceable funds into the campaign, highlighting concerns over the [influence of big money](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in politics.
* The race is highly significant as the district is a [Democratic stronghold](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), making the primary winner likely to succeed in the general election, and is seen as a battleground for more moderate versus progressive Democratic agendas.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Krannawitter: Campaign finance reform is to blame for prosecution of Trump](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY THOMAS KRANNAWITTER, PH.D., [LIBERTY LYCEUM SUBSTACK](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Campaign finance laws --not merely McCain-Feingold--were at the heart of the recent jury conviction of Donald Trump. A more accurate title, therefore, could be: Revenge of Campaign Finance Reform Laws.
_ _
__The essence of campaign finance laws and regulations should be offensive --even outrageous--to self-governing United States citizens. Imagine those in government commanding how and when and whether you spend your own money, and then demanding detailed reports when you do.
_ _
__That 's what campaign finance reform laws are all about: Controlling the many in ways that benefit established, incumbent political elites._
__
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

name: Pete Sepp
subject: Urgent: Stop the Global Minimum Tax
body:
President Biden wants Americans to believe that the economy is booming, but no one is buying what he’s selling.

| | | [](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zs3a0qu6qk1mtsbloegdt1g90tq1qp73e0op9cd0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s9i6eo30clh2bs)
Friend,

President Biden wants Americans to believe that the economy is booming, but no one is buying what he’s selling.
* Americans are struggling with jaw-dropping price increases on essentials like eggs, gas, and rent.
* Budget deficits continue to soar.
* Small business optimism remains in the tank while banks tighten loan criteria.

_Is Biden interested in fixing these issues?**Nope!**_

Instead, his administration is working with bureaucrats in Paris to implement a scheme called the Global Minimum Tax, which was really designed to target American companies.

If Biden’s global tax scheme goes as planned, U.S. firms will be taxed more, while their customers — that means YOU — pay the bill. _This is terrible news for ALL Americans._

**The good news is that YOU can help stop this global tax scheme.**

Before I say more, allow me to introduce myself. My name is Pete Sepp, the president of the National Taxpayers Union (NTU). NTU is the “Voice of America’s Taxpayers.” We’re lobbyists for taxpayers like YOU, not the special interests. We work on Capitol Hill, across Washington, in the states, and in the courts.

[NTU is the only pro-taxpayer organization consistently raising the alarm about the Global Minimum Tax. You can help NTU stop Biden’s global tax scheme by contributing $35, $100, $250, or even more today.](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zh1j6dj02rdu6cogimqqoso9k4138lc493uia6fo_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s9i6eo30clh2bs)
[Donate](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z7gc802f54j268p0qpls40v6nl91va9fuq4i7i6g_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s9i6eo30clh2bs)
**The National Taxpayers Union’s plan to stop the Global Minimum Tax requires a few steps.**

**First, we must ensure that more people know about Biden’s global tax scheme.**

This is _one of the most dangerous tax proposals we’ve seen in decades_ , and no one wants to talk about it!

NTU is sounding the “red alert” and building coalitions to amplify our warnings about Biden’s latest tax scheme.

**Second, we must convince more members of Congress that Biden’s Global Minimum Tax is a treaty, not everyday legislation.**

Some Biden Administration officials have suggested that Congress should approve the US participation in the Global Minimum Tax through the normal legislative process — a simple majority in the House and a simple majority in the Senate.

_**No way!**_

We need to get more members to push for the Constitutional requirement of a two-thirds vote in the Senate.

| | It’s been another busy few weeks in Jersey! We had our campaign office opening, I announced new legislation to protect seniors, and announced new investments my office secured for first responders in the District – and much more!

In one of my biggest wins, my colleagues and I were proud to pass the Antisemitism Awareness Act with overwhelming bipartisan support in the House of Representatives. The Act would push educational institutions to protect Jewish students from intimidation and harassment. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86747606/478884628/617902559?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_JG_20240612_ST_Newsletter_0_3MO_JoshGottheimer_NA_NA_NA&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDczNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MzBmMzVlYS1jOTI4LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xNYXpXGLv27iZFlNVBmMcY6yV4ypqZLNjmhL8-BlBNw=) We officially opened our campaign office! I was proud to be joined by Bergen County Chairman Paul Juliano, Sussex County Chairwoman Zoe Heath, elected officials from across the District, and scores of energized volunteers ready to deliver wins up and down the ballot in Jersey’s Fifth! If you’d be interested in joining the volunteer team, you may do so [HERE.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86747607/478884629/-470597108?source=EM_NBI_JG_20240612_ST_Newsletter_0_3MO_JoshGottheimer_NA_NA_NA&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDczNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MzBmMzVlYS1jOTI4LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xNYXpXGLv27iZFlNVBmMcY6yV4ypqZLNjmhL8-BlBNw=&emci=0165f818-1228-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=830f35ea-c928-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=37438246) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86747608/478884630/617902559?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_JG_20240612_ST_Newsletter_0_3MO_JoshGottheimer_NA_NA_NA&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDczNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MzBmMzVlYS1jOTI4LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xNYXpXGLv27iZFlNVBmMcY6yV4ypqZLNjmhL8-BlBNw=) As part of my Senior Security Strategy, I visited the Fair Lawn Senior Center to sound the alarm about one of the biggest issues facing older Americans: senior scams. I discussed new action against scammers – including the Empowering States to Protect Seniors Against Bad Actors Act – which will equip states with the tools to combat financial exploitation and fraudsters. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86747609/478884631/617902559?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_JG_20240612_ST_Newsletter_0_3MO_JoshGottheimer_NA_NA_NA&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDczNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MzBmMzVlYS1jOTI4LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xNYXpXGLv27iZFlNVBmMcY6yV4ypqZLNjmhL8-BlBNw=) In New Milford, I highlighted millions in new investments – clawed back from Washington – to ensure our brave first responders have the equipment, training, and resources they need to protect themselves and our families.

[Contributions like yours help us get out around Jersey and remind folks that we are the Party of commonsense.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86747610/478884632/617902559?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_JG_20240612_ST_Newsletter_0_3MO_JoshGottheimer_NA_NA_NA&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDczNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MzBmMzVlYS1jOTI4LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xNYXpXGLv27iZFlNVBmMcY6yV4ypqZLNjmhL8-BlBNw=) Thank you for your continued support!

Yours,

Josh

clean_body: | | It’s been another busy few weeks in Jersey! We had our campaign office opening, I announced new legislation to protect seniors, and announced new investments my office secured for first responders in the District – and much more! In one of my biggest wins, my colleagues and I were proud to pass the Antisemitism Awareness Act with overwhelming bipartisan support in the House of Representatives. The Act would push educational institutions to protect Jewish students from intimidation and harassment. = We officially opened our campaign office! I was proud to be joined by Bergen County Chairman Paul Juliano, Sussex County Chairwoman Zoe Heath, elected officials from across the District, and scores of energized volunteers ready to deliver wins up and down the ballot in Jersey’s Fifth! If you’d be interested in joining the volunteer team, you may do so = As part of my Senior Security Strategy, I visited the Fair Lawn Senior Center to sound the alarm about one of the biggest issues facing older Americans: senior scams. I discussed new action against scammers – including the Empowering States to Protect Seniors Against Bad Actors Act – which will equip states with the tools to combat financial exploitation and fraudsters. = In New Milford, I highlighted millions in new investments – clawed back from Washington – to ensure our brave first responders have the equipment, training, and resources they need to protect themselves and our families. = Thank you for your continued support! June 12, 2024
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
CONTACT: Houston Keene
press@nancyforalaska.com

ICYMI: Nancy Dahlstrom Joins Fellow E-PAC Candidates on Fox & Friends

ANCHORAGE, AK - In case you missed it, Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom
joined her fellow Elevate PAC (E-PAC) candidates for a panel discussion
on Fox & Friends Wednesday morning to discuss her campaign and the
importance of electing conservative women leaders into office.

Republican women are in the middle of a political Renaissance and are
defying the liberal media's stereotype that women always fall in line
with the Democratic Party. Dahlstrom spoke on the wide-open southern
border, Joe Biden's executive orders targeting Alaska, and more.

<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=68963&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=61430>

"This election is going to be consequential for our country. We have so
many things at stake," Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom said. "In Alaska
specifically, we have been hit so hard by the things this
administration has done. President Biden has issued over 60 executive
orders that are just basically trying to shut our state down."

"We're an oil and gas state, we're a mining state, we have all kind of
minerals and things here that the entire country needs," Dahlstrom
continued. "And we need those things for many reasons, not just
production but also for national security. If we don't have those
things in our country, we have to rely on other countries."

"And so we have to have a change in D.C. We have got to have President
Trump back in office. We need to get the course reversed that we are
on," Dahlstrom added.

You can watch the full Fox & Friends interview by clicking here

body:
President Biden wants Americans to believe that the economy is booming, but no one is buying what he’s selling.

| | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zlb50d94n8rc0jrfost16g1973aomgf0jigt37cg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s9i6ep76cdh2bs)
Friend,

President Biden wants Americans to believe that the economy is booming, but no one is buying what he’s selling.
* Americans are struggling with jaw-dropping price increases on essentials like eggs, gas, and rent.
* Budget deficits continue to soar.
* Small business optimism remains in the tank while banks tighten loan criteria.

| | | Peter, I’ve been on the road helping our candidates so often lately that it’s rare I get to sleep in my own bed anymore. But each time I get the news that someone we endorsed won their election, I know it’s worth it. Here’s a few of the places I’ve been lately:
* Orlando, FL to support Nate Douglas. At 23 years old, Nate would be the youngest person in the Florida legislature.
* Atlanta, GA to support Bryce Berry. He’s 22 years old and would be the first public school teacher ever elected to the state legislature.
* Houston, TX to support Molly Cook. She’s also 23 years old and is currently the youngest and most progressive member of the Texas Senate.

[This work is tiring, but it’s worth it to elect so many awesome young leaders — and none of it is possible without your support. Can you pitch in $25 today to help us and Blue Amp Action PAC keep electing young leaders across the country?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te04dea2a-6bdf-4773-970d-eaa4acd65d8f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) One thing I’ve learned is that not everyone does it like us. A lot of big national organizations will parachute in, shell out thousands of dollars for really generic-seeming ads, and call it a day. But being on the ground, meeting campaign staff, and talking directly to voters allows us to invest your donations much more effectively because we know exactly the best place to spend it. We can identify what each campaign needs to move the needle in their races — whether that’s more doors knocked, a TV ad, a mail piece on a certain issue, or something else entirely. And the work is paying off, too. Last year we elected our first endorsed candidate, Nadarius Clark, in Virginia. Just a couple weeks ago, Molly Cook won a special election to serve out the remainder of the current term in the Texas Senate — AND she just won the Democratic primary runoff by only 74 votes! We’re looking forward to electing Nate, Bryce, Molly, and all of our endorsed candidates this November, but we truly cannot do it without your support. As a grassroots organization, we don’t take corporate donations. We’re counting on your help to support each of the candidates we endorse. [So Peter, if you want to help us keep elected fantastic young leaders all over the country, please split a donation of $25 to Leaders We Deserve and Blue Amp Action today.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T94b0a3f1-9eb5-4abf-9505-c221f2a994ab/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | Dear Fellow Patriot, If you opened this letter because you remember my playing days with the Dodgers and the Padres, thank you. Having you and all of America's baseball fans cheering for me and Davey Lopes, Bill Russell, Ron Cey and the rest of the guys as we battled Reggie Jackson, Thurman Munson and the Yankees... ...well, as they say, "Those were the days." But this email - isn't about baseball in fact, it's an email I never thought I'd be writing to you. **[Today, I'm asking you to help me defeat the radical Adam Schiff for a seat in the United States Senate.](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=23cb1f73dbe048db95575fe5891db464&_e=xbIT1RigAtNyOKnOmkTd_ckJLLBB5MeMW1Xes7ZM6-t6oa5VsfaqPOQtAj2BTPzzaGwMVrWxBvvu59kL1vQ762H04O2edEOTWOZdiR0s1JXy6-UvZ3OibcR74f5ZW1283aDTuuztvr_4-ZjLBFDnQo1prp0fxnA9UtXnO7Y0BHDf9w9MTBXCeK4nE8luT2lxadcOuG5MjfiiCQuqf5BdAE96cN6I0gQ5F5RguHnWHVkhtH78FbXQ1MURcSw528qr4WVeh_mgIAPeCLZZVU7Ps4fKpJGCUT0GDMquNymSkOD0ssFglu6PeMIzq8V8eIYMRV2t7sKFGh818KC6Cb4rRMBQmUHVRzfVkRI5WNLsNVKXlT6Q1jG6iDYVYrUbbwi0AvBbnvb0niTknVhTLMN8mA%3D%3D)** Today, I'm asking you to help me start a Republican Comeback Rally that folks will be talking about for generations to come. Because when you think about it, those 'good-ol' days of the 1970s weren't as good as we tend to first remember. Baseball was just a welcome distraction from the gloom and malaise that had settled on our country thanks to one failed Democrat policy after another. I'm running for the United States Senate because 2024 America is starting to look a lot like 1970s America. You remember what it was like: ► Not only were gas prices sky high, Carter's rationing meant we could only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license plate numbers. **_Remember?_** ► Eleven Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in Munich by terrorists. _**Remember?**_ ► Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists in Iran. _**Remember?**_ Democrat policies had brought America to its knees. And now, as Yogi Berra used to say, "It's deja vu all over again." There's fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding and for the first time causing more people to leave California. Joe Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don't care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and dependent. And I wouldn't blame you if you said, "Steve, I'm afraid America's best days are behind us." But listen, here's something I also want you to remember... **_We_ _Republicans_ pulled our country out of that 1970's Democratic malaise by electing Ronald Reagan. ** **We put classic conservative values at the heart of everything we did.** **And America became a shining city upon a hill once more.** **_We_ _can_ _do_ _that_ _again._** **It starts by stunning the Democrats with a Senate win in California.** **But there's no way I can pull it off without you.** [**That's why I'm asking you to rush back your _Garvey for Senate_ contribution of $35 or more right away. **](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=23cb1f73dbe048db95575fe5891db464&_e=xbIT1RigAtNyOKnOmkTd_ckJLLBB5MeMW1Xes7ZM6-t6oa5VsfaqPOQtAj2BTPzzaGwMVrWxBvvu59kL1vQ762H04O2edEOTWOZdiR0s1JXy6-UvZ3OibcR74f5ZW1283aDTuuztvr_4-ZjLBFDnQo1prp0fxnA9UtXnO7Y0BHDf9w9MTBXCeK4nE8luT2lxadcOuG5MjfiiCQuqf5BdAE96cN6I0gQ5F5RguHnWHVkhtH78FbXQ1MURcSw528qrHs-Ld89tuzhIdAIbX-46eFqQeBrFqoYGR7GwEHDG7_nutQJwK2KHHKLAEyrqbFJ2tUTDHRmvplfh36kiRvnRmVaUkGatP-Zrwc4tQyN9w74y8jxIQ3pqq4__TQPp38sxgH6KCVz2m_UW31viAF2YpQ%3D%3D) I'm sorry for the urgency but Election Day is just six months away... And in that time, we need to build a 58-county, grassroots campaign capable of defeating Adam Schiff who has ActBlue allies and a war chest he's assembled during his two decades in Washington, D.C. That may seem daunting, but I know with your help, I can beat him in November. Why? First... I've lived and worked in California for over 50 years, and I can tell you -- voters here have had it with the Democrats like I've never seen before. They are hungry for change, and if you and I work together to reach voters in every neighborhood, on every beach, in every corner of California... I know we can turn this historic opportunity into a Republican win. Second... you know I'm not a career politician. But I do have the _one_ _thing_ a Republican needs to get elected in California... ...name recognition. I'm no Schwarzenegger and I'd certainly never dare compare myself to President Reagan. But California voters know me. And Adam Schiff and the Democrats are shaking in their boots seeing how quickly I rose in the polls after entering the race. As I'm writing you this letter, there are just a few percentage points separating us. We've got a shot -- a very real shot -- in the general election. But we only have six months. And the giant Democrat political machine is going to use every second of that time trying to bury me and our common sense message. [**When you rush your _Garvey for Senate_ campaign contribution of $35 or more... **](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=23cb1f73dbe048db95575fe5891db464&_e=xbIT1RigAtNyOKnOmkTd_ckJLLBB5MeMW1Xes7ZM6-t6oa5VsfaqPOQtAj2BTPzzaGwMVrWxBvvu59kL1vQ762H04O2edEOTWOZdiR0s1JXy6-UvZ3OibcR74f5ZW1283aDTuuztvr_4-ZjLBFDnQo1prp0fxnA9UtXnO7Y0BHDf9w9MTBXCeK4nE8luT2lxadcOuG5MjfiiCQuqf5BdAE96cN6I0gQ5F5RguHnWHVkhtH78FbXQ1MURcSw528qrgUYqOEHZOGaY3aIbMIV9lxnLtmfKhp_GOEt_mudIp2vdfSr1lDI1J918WpTqGEEo67xVQzQShhbSpnMsJFkUWIG7fC2V1tXNPlAM1Giq6Fqby6JXqZOORz9RHUptI7-e-542tAl9WPagbhQN1Z1ZmA%3D%3D) ...you're helping fund ads, appearances, events, fliers, door knockers, EVERYTHING that blankets California with the message: _You don't have to accept failed Democrat policies that make _all of us_ less safe, less prosperous, and less free. _ This race is the toughest in the nation. But they say the hardest thing to do in sports is hit a 95-mph fastball. And you know I've done that plenty of times. Now I'm ready to do the hardest thing in American politics -- win in California as a common sense Republican. But I can't do it without you. When we win here... when we rip this seat out of the hands of the radical Adam Schiff... ...we start the _nationwide_ Republican Comeback Rally our country desperately needs. It all depends on the choice you make in the next 48 hours. You can do nothing and continue to suffer the agony of defeat. Or you can step up to the plate with me and take a swing for the thrill of victory. Please join me. Because when we win in California, we're winning for all of America.

#
Peter — **there is no U.S. Senator more personally responsible for the threats to in vitro fertilization and contraception than Josh Hawley.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52139?refcode=em20240612-5747&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5747%2E614464%2EKrutDV)

**FIRST:** _The Guardian_ exposed Josh Hawley’s role in the shutdowns of IVF clinics in Alabama earlier this year. Hawley’s legal arguments from leading the Hobby Lobby case — that contraception _“may induce an abortion by preventing implantation of a fertilized egg”_ — served as the foundation for the Alabama ruling. Those same arguments continue to threaten access to IVF in other states with “personhood” laws like Missouri.
**Hawley even cosponsored a federal version of that “personhood” law, putting IVF access at risk nationwide.**
**THEN:** Just last week, Hawley voted against the Right to Contraception Act in the U.S. Senate. It was no big surprise, considering one of the highlights of Hawley’s career was working on the Hobby Lobby case aimed at letting employers decide whether to restrict access to birth control for their workers.
**NOW: New reporting in Missouri confirmed that the future of IVF remains uncertain.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52139?refcode=em20240612-5747&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5747%2E614464%2EKrutDV)

**Hawley said his crusade to end reproductive freedom is _“core to who I am”_ — and he’s spent six years in the U.S. Senate proving that to all of us.**
He led the charge to overturn Roe v. Wade by appointing control-obsessed judges and writing amicus briefs from his taxpayer-funded U.S. Senate office. That paved the way for Missouri’s total abortion ban, enacted just minutes after Roe was overturned, which is regarded as one of the most extreme bans in the country.
In the weeks after Roe fell, Hawley even co-sponsored a _national_ abortion ban in the U.S. Senate.
And _right now,_ the Supreme Court is considering the case argued by Josh Hawley’s wife and originally ruled on by Josh Hawley’s campaign donor judge to ban the most commonly used abortion pill, mifepristone, in all 50 states. We’re expecting their decision any day now.
**[FIGHT BACK NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52139?refcode=em20240612-5747&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=5747%2E614464%2EKrutDV)**
**Hawley has spent his first term proving that he wants absolute control over how we build our families and live our lives.** We can’t afford to give him another.
Lucas Kunce is the 13-year Marine veteran running to replace Josh Hawley and take back power for working Missourians. He wants to end Hawley’s attacks on reproductive freedom — from abortion to birth control to IVF — and finally put everyday people in charge of their own bodies, families, and lives. And this year, we have a real opportunity to make it happen.
Hawley’s failure to actually stand up for our state has earned him the lowest approval rating of any GOP U.S. Senator up for re-election this year. If we’re going to win this race, we need your help to keep exposing his record and getting the truth in front of Missouri voters every day until November 5.
**That’s why we’re urgently asking for your help, Peter:[ Will you rush a donation of $10, $25, or just whatever works best for you today? body:
A Call to Action for Our Future
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1267%2E62735%2Eh0HzXQ)
Peter,
Today, we commemorate the anniversary of the landmark Supreme Court decision in Loving v. Virginia, a ruling that changed the course of American history. **On this day in 1967, the Supreme Court struck down laws banning interracial marriage, affirming that love transcends race and that the right to marry is a fundamental human right.**
It's almost unimaginable now that not so long ago, people were denied the basic right to love and marry whomever they chose. Loving v. Virginia was a monumental step forward in our fight for civil rights and equality, a powerful reminder that justice and love must always triumph over prejudice and hate.
As we reflect on the significance of this decision, we're reminded of the ongoing struggle for equality and justice in our country. Today, we face another pivotal moment in our nation's history—the overturning of Roe v. Wade. **Just as it is inconceivable to us now that interracial marriage was once prohibited, future generations will look back in disbelief at a time when women's reproductive rights were under attack.**
I am running for the U.S. Senate to ensure that we continue to fight for justice, equality, and the protection of our fundamental rights. I understand that the fight is far from over, and I am committed to standing up for every American's right to make decisions about their own bodies.
My campaign is about more than just winning a Senate seat—it's about building a future where justice, equality, and love prevail. But I cannot do it alone. I need your support to bring this vision to life.
Will you join me in this fight?
[**Your donation, no matter the size, will make a significant impact. Together, we can ensure that future generations will look back on this time with pride, knowing that we stood up for what is right.**](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1722?t=2&akid=1267%2E62735%2Eh0HzXQ)

With gratitude and determination,

As you already know, in 2008 we experienced one of

Markets around the world crashed. Stock prices
dropped. Once "invincible" financial institutions started showing
signs of collapse.

Then Governments "came to the rescue", handing out
massive bailouts and stimulus packages to keep the world economy
afloat.

We've been told these drastic measures prevented a
total collapse of our system...

But all it did was show the cracks in the system.
Many lost faith in the financial system and the U.S Government.

And now it's possible things could get worse. The
savings of regular working class Americans could be in serious
trouble.

Click here to learn how to protect yourself now
before it's too late!

We're nearly $35 TRILLION in debt, and if that

Your money could go to zero. Here's how:

interest rates to cover the growing risk of buying Treasuries.
This could trigger a further debt spiral, leaving Washington
short of money.

In other words? Boom.

Because once our debt collectors come knocking on

owed…

Friend,
I grew up in Brooklyn as the son of an exterminator and a stay-at-home mom and as a descendant of victims of the Holocaust. My friend Jacky Rosen grew up in a working-class family as the granddaughter of Jewish immigrants and the daughter of a World War II veteran.
Our humble origins and shared Jewish faith are at the core of what motivates our work together in the Senate as we fight every day to make progress for hardworking Americans – _but that could soon come to an end for both of us._
**The race to the general election starts today, and the stakes are higher than ever – and Jacky is counting on us to stand by her side.**

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Remembering the victims of Pulse
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

Friends -
On this day eight years ago, we learned of the heartbreaking news that a mass shooter had killed forty-nine individuals at Pulse Nightclub, an LGBTQ+ nightclub in Orlando, FL.
Pulse Nightclub used to be a safe space, a place where you could dance and celebrate and be yourself. But that safety was shattered within a matter of seconds by a hate-filled man armed with a gun. Each and every day, the Orlando community is still healing from the loss of these forty-nine innocent souls whose lives were stolen from them.
As we honor Pride Month this June, I hope you will join me in standing with LGBTQ+ individuals across our nation. In the years since the tragedy at Pulse Nightclub, we’ve seen ongoing threats and violence against the LGBTQ+ and Latino communities. Nobody should ever fear that they will be hurt because of who they are or who they love.
We must work towards a future where hate-filled individuals can no longer access firearms and harm our nation’s most vulnerable populations. I hope you will continue to stand with me in this vital fight.
In solidarity,
Gabby Giffords

name: Wes Moore
subject: The Fort McHenry Channel is reopened
body:
Friend

As of Monday evening, we fully re-opened Fort McHenry Channel and restored business at the Port of Baltimore.
One of our top priorities in the wake of the collapse of the Francis Scott Key Bridge was to reopen the federal channel as quickly as possible. By working together, we turned a months-long projected timeline into weeks — and bounced back faster than anyone could have anticipated.

I applaud and sincerely appreciate the many partners who made this possible – from the Unified Command to the federal delegation to the Biden-Harris administration. This has been a remarkably complex operation, spanning thousands of people, hundreds of assets, and multiple objectives. Our achievement is government cooperation at its best.

With the Fort McHenry Channel now open, more Marylanders can get back to work at the Port of Baltimore. Now, our focus remains on rebuilding the Francis Scott Key Bridge.

When we stand united, we achieve our goals. Together, we will continue to prove the full meaning of Maryland Tough and Baltimore Strong.

Elevate,

Wes

Contribute » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20240612-1?refcode=em20240612-1]

Derek -- Last night in Ohio, a Democrat running in a special election for Congress got within spitting distance of flipping a Trump +30 seat. And while we lost last night by a slim margin, it’s clear: **Democrats continue to overperform expectations.**
* 2022 was the best midterm election performance for a sitting president since FDR.

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to hear about this exciting event taking place June 17th, brought to you in part by Illinois Review (https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c7703e93c5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

Attn Grassroots:
Roger Stone is Coming to IL!
https://www.theconservativecaucus.org/event-details/roger-stone?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c7703e93c5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Joe Biden and his Democratic political operatives have convicted President Donald Trump on fake crimes and now they want him to go to jail! But they are not after Trump – they’re after us – and we’re next. This election in November is the most important in the history of our country because so much is at stake, including our very existence as conservative grassroot Republicans.

On June 17, in the northwest suburbs of Chicago, GOP strategist and political icon Roger Stone will be in town to headline a fundraiser in support of The Conservative Caucus. Founded in 1974 in Washington, DC, The Conservative Caucus is the oldest conservative grassroots organization in the country.

The event features a private VIP reception and meet and greet with Roger Stone, followed by the main event. For sponsors, enjoy a private, off-the-record dinner discussion with Roger.
For tickets or to be a sponsor, please visit:
https://www.theconservativecaucus.org/event-details/roger-stone?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c7703e93c5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

About Roger Stone:

Roger Stone is a legendary Republican strategist, political icon and pundit, who has served as a senior campaign aide to 3 Republican presidents including Richard Nixon and Ronald Reagan. He is a New York Times bestselling author and a longtime friend and advisor to President Donald Trump since 1978.

As an outspoken Libertarian, Stone has appeared on thousands of broadcasts, spoken at countless venues and lectured before the prestigious Oxford Political Union and the Cambridge Union Society. Due to his over 40 years in the political and cultural arena, Stone has become a pop culture icon.

In 2016, Netflix launched a documentary called Get Me Roger Stone that featured interviews with Donald Trump, and it’s been viewed by tens of millions of people from around the world.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/yassaminansari_em?refcode=wrpr_hdr [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/yassaminansari_em?refcode=wrpr_hdr] Peter, I'm so proud to share this news. https://secure.actblue.com/donate/yassaminansari_em?refcode=240612_ya_unhoused_img [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/yassaminansari_em?refcode=240612_ya_unhoused_img] For the first time in 7 years, the number of people experiencing homelessness in the Valley dropped. Today, more of our most vulnerable neighbors are sleeping inside than outside — a first since 2019. It took a lot of work to get here. Housing is an important issue for our community and finding solutions to decrease homelessness has been a top priority for me. On my first day as Councilwoman, I toured the Human Services Campus and spent time over the summer personally doing outreach in what was formerly known as “the Zone.” Earlier this year, my team and I participated in the 2024 point-in-time survey of everyone experiencing homelessness in our city. During my time on the Phoenix City Council, we added over 1,000 beds to our shelter system , approved a record number of new housing units , and allocated over $140 million in American Rescue Plan funding for affordable housing and rental assistance . Plus, we led the charge to pass progressive housing reforms, like the legalization of casitas. But Phoenix still receives thousands fewer federal housing vouchers than we need. Families across the nation are still at risk of eviction, and we need to build thousands more units of affordable housing in cities like ours. That's why I have a comprehensive plan to champion progressive housing policy in Congress. You can read it right here. Please read the following message from our sponsor.

When The Government Says "Don't Worry",Then It's
Time To Panic…

When The Government Says "Don't Worry",Then It's
Time To Panic…

As you already know, in 2008 we experienced one of
the greatest financial meltdowns in modern history.

Markets around the world crashed. Stock prices
dropped. Once "invincible" financial institutions started showing
signs of collapse.

Then Governments "came to the rescue", handing out
massive bailouts and stimulus packages to keep the world economy
afloat.

We've been told these drastic measures prevented a
total collapse of our system...

But all it did was show the cracks in the system.
Many lost faith in the financial system and the U.S Government.

And now it's possible things could get worse. The
savings of regular working class Americans could be in serious
trouble.

Click here to learn how to protect yourself now
before it's too late!

We're nearly $35 TRILLION in debt, and if that
bubble pops?

Your money could go to zero. Here's how:

Once investors who are buying Treasury securities
(which finance the U.S. government's debt) start to think the
United States is in over its head, they may demand higher
interest rates to cover the growing risk of buying Treasuries.
This could trigger a further debt spiral, leaving Washington
short of money.

In other words? Boom.

Because once our debt collectors come knocking on
our door, we're screwed. $34 trillion in debt would be
owed…

Which means every legal citizen would owe more than
$101,000.

But there IS something you could do…

exactly why THOUSANDS have used this IRS Loophole to possibly

Act now! It only takes seconds.

The next step is yours, and it could mean a future

name: Neil Parrott
subject: Trump, my wife, and Berney
body:
Guess who shares a birthday with President Trump. My wife, April! Will you join me this Friday, June 14, Flag Day, in Gaithersburg? | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=db9db98fed)
---
| |
---
| Peter,

Guess who shares a birthday with President Trump.

My wife, April! Will you join me this Friday, June 14, Flag Day, at the Chinese Culture & Community Center in Gaithersburg? A VIP Reception will be held from 5-6:30pm, and the Dinner will begin at 6:30pm.

I need your support now more than ever, and this Friday will be a fun way to get involved. Could you donate $6, $15, $50, $100, or $250? Even if you can’t join us, your donation is so appreciated.

We are at the stage in this campaign where we need to raise significant funds. Quickly. ** ** All eyes are on this open Congressional Seat in Maryland, and **in order to gain national funding, we have to post solid numbers by June 30.** Can you help?

If you could sponsor the event for $1,000.88 or $500.88 or $250.88, great. If you are able to attend for $100.88, great. If you are able to donate any amount, great. Our country is worth fighting for, and your donation will be used wisely and with great intention.
---
| [Donate to Neil; For Our Country](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=bc3879c091&e=5a45ee1154 "Donate to Neil; For Our Country")
---

---
| | Why did I mention Berney? Well, Berney Flowers, former congressional candidate and author of _Black Values Matter_ , will be at the dinner with us this Friday, and I believe that you will be very interested to hear what he has to say.

I will also be talking about the new paradigm in Maryland politics. We’ve learned a lot. You may be surprised to hear what the far left has been doing, and how it is now perfectly legal according to Maryland law. What will we do about it? Several very specific things. We will talk about it on Friday.

So whether you will be celebrating April’s birthday, President Trump’s birthday, Flag Day, or all three, we’d love to talk with you on Friday. Your encouragement means a great deal to both me and April, and I hope you’ll be able to join us.

For our country,
Neil

P.S. April will be making Elephant Cookies for the Silent Auction, and as anyone who has tried her pies knows, she is a great baker. You may not want to miss this!

| | 1\. The Pledge: Silence = Death, How We Save Our Nation
---
| | I made a pledge today, and I ask you to do the same. All evidence points to Democrats inadvertently strengthening Donald Trump. In our rage and naivety, we are empowering the very thing we want to destroy: MAGA. I will give you three concrete reasons to make this pledge. Share it with others and make it our mission until DJT and MAGA are erased.
---
| |
---
| | No Trump post was made by a Trump organization; they were all by liberal media. With the exception of two posts, all of Pro-Biden posts were made by the Biden administration; none were made by liberal media or persons that identify as Democrats.
---
| | The credo Silence = Death is very powerful to me. Turning twenty in 1981, at the start of the AIDS crisis, I quickly learned that without a strong and demanding voice, you could be easily dismissed. I use that same conviction, Silence = Death, to put an end to Donald Trump and MAGA ideology.
---
| |
---
| | Google Trends; Donald Trump is talked about more than Biden in every state!
---
| | I was at a gathering last week. It was nice and filled with smart, informed people. During the conversations, two women in their thirties expressed their frustration with both parties. They claimed both were corrupt, that Biden was draining the country’s resources, leaving no future, and driving us into a depression. None of this is true, but this is what they believed. We can debate the facts, but not their perception of the situation. How did we get here?
---

| | Pledge Silence = Death
---
| | Three reasons: Ego, Money, and Algorithms. What occupies my thoughts? Not Biden’s successes, but the latest Trump horror show. We are drawn to the spectacle, and like all things negative, it takes a devastating toll on us. Our obsession with Trump, according to studies, is weakening the sense of right and good. Constant exposure to violence moves liberals towards conservative thinking, which cannot be allowed. Instead of supporting our candidate, we are feeding the monster, and this must stop. It only increases his power and weakens us. How does this work?
---
| |
---
| | Google Trends: The only topics where Biden leads in all states.
---
| |
1. Ego: We all succumb to it at some point. We talk, like, post, share, and ruminate on our outrage. Has a good outcome ever come from a singular focus on the bad? No. Whether raising a child or winning a war, focusing on the good in us spurs us on. Don’t let the desire for likes or losing sight of real reasons blind you.
2. Money: It drives everything! Your power lies in opening newsletters, reading posts, and liking and sharing content. Content creators, both amateur and professional, need to feed their audience, and you will get more of what you engage with. Every time you give attention to DJT or his minions, you ensure more will follow. Stop acknowledging him, and the content will change.
3. Algorithms: They are more powerful and insidious than most think. They determine our likes and dislikes but the real power lies in grouping people based on online behavior and other data. When you like a post, more similar content appears in your feed, and more people like you see it too. What it doesn’t do is make it prevalent in feeds of people unlike you. It also limits non-conforming content in your feed. If you like Trump, you won’t see Biden. How does that help?

Missy and I voted early today! If you live in the district and haven’t already voted, you can do so Thursday or Friday. **[**Find your polling location here.**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/8c30722d3644710666a6b3c4b83ff292/45443/d3e152efd9b64de73947229f28c3afba/6dff35e12ac43b8dc3d6b838967d376c/45443)** **[**After we voted, we recorded a quick video you can watch here or below.**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/8c30722d3644710666a6b3c4b83ff292/45443/d3e152efd9b64de73947229f28c3afba/5f58e3face7a7021c3d6b838967d376c/45443)**

We live here, work here, and raised our family here. It’d be an honor to serve our community in Congress. **Here’s one key difference between Brian Jack and me in the latest FEC fundraising report:** **— > *Less than 1% of Brian Jack’s donations are from the 3rd District.* ** **— > *Just 4% of his donations are from Georgia.* ** **So, who’s he running to serve? **[**Want to volunteer in the final days of the campaign? Email my campaign manager here.**](mailto:ben@votemikedugan.com "ben@votemikedugan.com")** With your help, we’ll run through the tape, beat the odds, and win this seat. Let’s go!

I hope you're having a great day so far. I'm reaching out to share something important with you...something that could expand your horizons. I'm talking about studying American history! As Hillsdale College professor Wilfred McClay explains in our online course ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope,"](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f78bef5b64e2476db798f98ce8c4feae&_e=g96FwMnJWDNBc9-ZGDlrA9-S9WDhADrmK9cP1izb89i-nVrQNS3YkVyJIw1eUw8ZO3jEeNQC7IW68Gt_1AKXBMJCnaatdwDoAN6f_vuYCUcJ_NE8ctwW8KAHyWZkNvFZVS_a3tUiSTAmjALQuzRpE29dzYLwEGTQcutqd2bGPd37oQfs6DRnqMPTXhnEV9qfPVsycqDU6v9feMHy2h1pjbdkoAUBLLBmYPttZbASUda2Nr_083oWnuryZaSSiYbb3dRy4XAj8s9_qS06I4G-H_qghwsdXEA1S0_j_H1ELacsMz6ckYaDJVpHnd3T-3QR3NnC1UlQCzzejKSYPKMqbYE-I4pQdAGrX2MgpZWe4aSVQUEGih6kkgMWXIakar779G1umxB4rayY5XTW7Tr9mu6GfDlbPA-OG4Zi9NIarUI%3D) studying history can broaden your perspective and help you understand different ways of living. Compare that to _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project," now a multi-part series streaming online. After the speech, dozens of enthusiastic people lined up for photos and words of encouragement, from college students to longtime activists from Veterans for Peace.

President Biden wants Americans to believe that the economy is booming, but no one is buying what he's selling.

| | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=39deb7335d7840929fc5ae20cbe7cf52&_e=yv0L1LrLue_WfSqCLKEnbsLTevWpBFMFLLbaJnYKLVf2iOSLSlMO15svT5BVPnAsVgb6OBYEUu3QLuYchmGZtl_bf6FImL0U7F9OMS4CEZdEej8i0rujAZrzePGAeeluFQ4Hm4rlOgkE9i1w77me1BBGOvntz2mGvXldG2168dTey7RaobMoCKSsfZvuQuNNTFRBCo8HWvr-HIvZB1Gt1H7rWahLs2BQ3KnwHsZM47x3HG7dxlmVaZ5tx8hScM9fvMGL39IBwOvqiv5zrNgA4tIsqch0ml_gB9pjxsGC6vbzXuDdTw7dY4d6w91bC8AGlodZpDNDn-v3cvA8u2LHop0Eto_uH-mb6gHS50LKqmY%3D)
Friend,

President Biden wants Americans to believe that the economy is booming, but no one is buying what he's selling.
* Americans are struggling with jaw-dropping price increases on essentials like eggs, gas, and rent.
* Budget deficits continue to soar.
* Small business optimism remains in the tank while banks tighten loan criteria.

_Is Biden interested in fixing these issues?**Nope!**_

Instead, his administration is working with bureaucrats in Paris to implement a scheme called the Global Minimum Tax, which was really designed to target American companies.

If Biden's global tax scheme goes as planned, U.S. firms will be taxed more, while their customers -- that means YOU -- pay the bill. _This is terrible news for ALL Americans._

**The good news is that YOU can help stop this global tax scheme.**

Before I say more, allow me to introduce myself. My name is Pete Sepp, the president of the National Taxpayers Union (NTU). NTU is the "Voice of America's Taxpayers." We're lobbyists for taxpayers like YOU, not the special interests. We work on Capitol Hill, across Washington, in the states, and in the courts.

[NTU is the only pro-taxpayer organization consistently raising the alarm about the Global Minimum Tax. This is _one of the most dangerous tax proposals we 've seen in decades_, and no one wants to talk about it!

NTU is sounding the "red alert" and building coalitions to amplify our warnings about Biden's latest tax scheme.

**Second, we must convince more members of Congress that Biden 's Global Minimum Tax is a treaty, not everyday legislation.**

Some Biden Administration officials have suggested that Congress should approve the US participation in the Global Minimum Tax through the normal legislative process -- a simple majority in the House and a simple majority in the Senate.

_**No way!**_

We need to get more members to push for the Constitutional requirement of a two-thirds vote in the Senate.

Small business optimism remains in the tank while banks tighten loan criteria. Is Biden interested in fixing these issues?Nope! Instead, his administration is working with bureaucrats in Paris to implement a scheme called the Global Minimum Tax, which was really designed to target American companies. If Biden's global tax scheme goes as planned, U.S. firms will be taxed more, while their customers -- that means YOU -- pay the bill. This is terrible news for ALL Americans. The good news is that YOU can help stop this global tax scheme. Before I say more, allow me to introduce myself. My name is Pete Sepp, the president of the National Taxpayers Union (NTU). NTU is the "Voice of America's Taxpayers." We're lobbyists for taxpayers like YOU, not the special interests. We work on Capitol Hill, across Washington, in the states, and in the courts. The National Taxpayers Union 's plan to stop the Global Minimum Tax requires a few steps. First, we must ensure that more people know about Biden 's global tax scheme. This is one of the most dangerous tax proposals we 've seen in decades, and no one wants to talk about it! NTU is sounding the "red alert" and building coalitions to amplify our warnings about Biden's latest tax scheme. Second, we must convince more members of Congress that Biden 's Global Minimum Tax is a treaty, not everyday legislation. Some Biden Administration officials have suggested that Congress should approve the US participation in the Global Minimum Tax through the normal legislative process -- a simple majority in the House and a simple majority in the Senate. No way! We need to get more members to push for the Constitutional requirement of a two-thirds vote in the Senate. NTU is alerting policymakers to the pitfalls and perils this tax-hike plan presents for U.S. taxpayers. Our team is working with members of Congress who are showing skepticism toward the Global Minimum Tax to prevent it from being railroaded through Congress. This is our best opportunity to get our representatives to do their jobs and push back against Biden 's tax scheme - before they start bugging out of Washington for the campaign trail. This Global Minimum Tax is effectively the international version of the " fair share" trope. The Europeans and the Biden administration are punishing American companies with a minimum tax of 15% because they don't think Americans pay their "fair share." This tax - where the funds will be sent outside the United States - will just get passed onto Americans who cannot afford it! Europeans don't get to trample on our nation's sovereignty. NTU is the ONLY taxpayer lobbying organization forcing everyone, every day, to pay attention to this threat to our sovereignty. And we 'll never look away from this until it is done. Dead and buried.
