**First, we must ensure that more people know about Biden’s global tax scheme.**

This is _one of the most dangerous tax proposals we’ve seen in decades_ , and no one wants to talk about it!

NTU is sounding the “red alert” and building coalitions to amplify our warnings about Biden’s latest tax scheme.

**Second, we must convince more members of Congress that Biden’s Global Minimum Tax is a treaty, not everyday legislation.**

Some Biden Administration officials have suggested that Congress should approve the US participation in the Global Minimum Tax through the normal legislative process — a simple majority in the House and a simple majority in the Senate.

_**No way!**_

We need to get more members to push for the Constitutional requirement of a two-thirds vote in the Senate.

NTU is alerting policymakers to the pitfalls and perils this tax-hike plan presents for U.S. taxpayers. Our team is working with members of Congress who are showing skepticism toward the Global Minimum Tax to prevent it from being railroaded through Congress.

If Biden’s global tax scheme goes as planned, U.S. firms will be taxed more, while their customers — that means YOU — pay the bill. This is terrible news for ALL Americans. The good news is that YOU can help stop this global tax scheme. Before I say more, allow me to introduce myself. My name is Pete Sepp, the president of the National Taxpayers Union (NTU). NTU is the “Voice of America’s Taxpayers.” We’re lobbyists for taxpayers like YOU, not the special interests. We work on Capitol Hill, across Washington, in the states, and in the courts. The National Taxpayers Union’s plan to stop the Global Minimum Tax requires a few steps. First, we must ensure that more people know about Biden’s global tax scheme. This is one of the most dangerous tax proposals we’ve seen in decades , and no one wants to talk about it! NTU is sounding the “red alert” and building coalitions to amplify our warnings about Biden’s latest tax scheme. Second, we must convince more members of Congress that Biden’s Global Minimum Tax is a treaty, not everyday legislation. Some Biden Administration officials have suggested that Congress should approve the US participation in the Global Minimum Tax through the normal legislative process — a simple majority in the House and a simple majority in the Senate. No way! We need to get more members to push for the Constitutional requirement of a two-thirds vote in the Senate. NTU is alerting policymakers to the pitfalls and perils this tax-hike plan presents for U.S. taxpayers. Our team is working with members of Congress who are showing skepticism toward the Global Minimum Tax to prevent it from being railroaded through Congress. This is our best opportunity to get our representatives to do their jobs and push back against Biden’s tax scheme – before they start bugging out of Washington for the campaign trail. This Global Minimum Tax is effectively the international version of the “fair share” trope. The Europeans and the Biden administration are punishing American companies with a minimum tax of 15% because they don’t think Americans pay their "fair share." This tax – where the funds will be sent outside the United States – will just get passed onto Americans who cannot afford it! Europeans don’t get to trample on our nation’s sovereignty. NTU is the ONLY taxpayer lobbying organization forcing everyone, every day, to pay attention to this threat to our sovereignty. And we’ll never look away from this until it is done. Dead and buried. We’re shouting this from the rooftops, but we need your help to inform taxpayers and convince Congress to stop the Global Minimum Tax. Please click any button below to fight against Biden’s tax scheme today. Thank you for your support. Pete Sepp President National Taxpayers Union P.S. The Global Minimum Tax means higher taxes for U.S. companies, higher costs for consumers, and a loss of economic sovereignty. You can help stop this dangerous tax proposal.** Your support will help NTU keep fighting for American taxpayers. You can help us stop the Global Minimum Tax and ensure our economy remains strong and competitive. NTU is a 501(c)(4) nonprofit, nonpartisan citizen group whose members work every day for lower taxes and smaller government at all levels. **__My Upbringing__**
I was raised in Zachary, Louisiana where I was taught the values I live by today by my mother and father. Those same values that I fight for each and every single day to protect. Values like hard work, dedication, and putting God and family first in everything.

I was elected to five terms as State Treasurer where I managed the state's $10.6 billion investment portfolios. I also oversaw local and state bond issues and returned millions of dollars in unclaimed property each year. Before I was Treasurer, I served as Secretary of the Department of Revenue, Special Counsel to Governor Roemer, and Secretary of Governor Roemer's Cabinet.

| | Hi friend, Believe it or not, the House voted to spend money on something that’ll actually do some good for once. Last week, we [passed](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=72433090950f4873ab9afc193f66b38b&_e=SO01u-67wK6QQlkC0YEHHv_8mnl1t1buAzCXsmlvesWA_Bvo8MnWsRy-l8xO8E5r4OR9lE8gz-M2fF2hoz5GKHJDWlJqHkgFdMKt1blAjo32IcQtdziBnwXqy5hYDwM5yXD9hJIHuirOSX1MIkC6N1aZsJ12T23WMfQG-vXWpHKmOqCbu2_-qBfTdsZxRpBLq9xLE_nS4FfO2BmNffP6dGTa_Bnlzn_CpxLZUkM1CEoLpRSrK-KLk_3ufaFBgjf0x9Uj4cNsbXCQ1fX_yZA34sMfUR9g88_2zZ2MlaMTh4_bdDNm6vfx4PARvAilsBh7gvd_JJkTJyGDHnjibVCAysJZ8DKTxMKthp9Ddo_PL3I%3D) the 2025 Military Construction, Veterans Affairs (VA), and Related Agencies Appropriations Act—better known as the MilCon-VA bill. This one’s [got a lot in it](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=72433090950f4873ab9afc193f66b38b&_e=SO01u-67wK6QQlkC0YEHHicr0iTHkTmwqcxXIUl_MwVhDKom3vMhB4_ha_GSYJ30yZX7PzQVnBwSOaxx-k0VhCnt3_OVISlDW3AflXS4-QHdeAME-HRzGB8ibfIY7oANDf__jtlsBmbzRLZ684Yl_Gzv92HOHD9cyL9IHgqOYscfHDJEVqH85gDNjBRgXB-Z4BJw32URpT_iIBWuT23DB2O8R_gAb_ygFXAfyWf5KNsSX38YWCcOXPeS3_r8Bl-Vrm_YC6OE7bhicDQvzdLP6sg9W_jEq7R26BGJvZswD7w%3D), but one crucial aspect would help veterans who were stupidly exposed to toxic burn pits while serving and sacrificing for our great nation. I’ll admit I’m not a big fan of the VA. I keep hearing from our veterans how tough it is to see a dadgum doctor. These amazing folks drive for hours to get to the nearest VA hospital, and even then, the care they get is hit-or-miss. We’ve passed reforms, but if you ask me, the VA is still tangled up in red tape and bureaucracy. I’d love to do away with it and let veterans see their own doctors, but right now, the VA is what we’re working with. Unfortunately, there's another challenge we're facing: Biden is [threatening to veto](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=72433090950f4873ab9afc193f66b38b&_e=SO01u-67wK6QQlkC0YEHHjetD7S5zOm-MkSunnZgSHDTCp7_RdpOH6b07hQPqIYANpJuE213NAi-CYDpaTCO_hgydK0l4cypPml40yVhXseYgsBbsEznZKpui3Kvan6hLvICrfHZWK2OSbGUu8SajHY6X2O1EsnHmOh6RmC7ul4i9CnxHhHc-8NTE0WSNuN4MwY8Qyrk0clf5lm85huAjCCbJAT3Ae1UBgl_Uw6QtbjNq-gH3OqsayIZ5TwdGMsPeiswbDP2GXUK7wwsPbCfBoMjaLTby2kJBf5Bw_fRf50%3D) the whole bill because he wants to stuff it with woke nonsense about [abortion access and climate change](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=72433090950f4873ab9afc193f66b38b&_e=SO01u-67wK6QQlkC0YEHHkGpXhb8XRnZpZvVAuYL_P7zScpOWlh3_bOiwbVPgjnwY2rg7kLUeziGXPvfjlhjsGZk50lJCaeTOE5Olbx4UoAcKf84DteuHs6xS3HZUZzK28Wax0jPWCHKCbItPOQ1Gif_GElRI7USxmWTxXkztkJAr3dZX2f6ghqDoha1S5UYZVG9CPTec8FWvEG_JJNuEsLNPA0qmxHygTT9nueY4ZEPt_YjsllySRN3Jk8EQY0jFxSS98oKuFEbMbAnk8Xa27zFgMC_Ef4fq8HOWJ7t65w%3D). **[Bottom line: We need to make sure our veterans get the care they deserve. * Greg Gutfeld, _Fox News_ co-host of _The Five_ , said, “Hunter is going to jail so Joe doesn’t have to.”
* _Fox News_ prime-time host Jesse Watters claimed, “The CIA and FBI and the Treasury Department are all in on the cover-up.”
* Texas Congressman Lance Gooden called the conviction “smoke and mirrors” orchestrated by “the Biden DOJ.”

Here’s the thing, Peter. We already know the right wing is willing to say anything to protect and enable Donald Trump. They’ve shown over and over again that they will tell any lie, no matter how dangerous, to make it look like Trump is under attack from some vast Democratic conspiracy.

Peter,

As the mother of three boys, I know the terror a parent feels when there is an active shooter alert at their children’s school.

I'll never forget the layers of emotions: the panic, fear, and then the absolute sense of helplessness—feeling that there is nothing you can do to protect them, whether they are thousands of miles away or just a mile down the road.

_**This Gun Violence Awareness Month reminds us of the deadliest epidemic facing American children.**_ Across our country, too many of our children endure school lockdowns, and too many of us have lost loved ones to gun violence.

_**And unfortunately, my Democratic opponent is part of the problem.**_ She sided with the NRA to vote against banning untraceable ghost guns – which are used in many crimes, often by criminals who shoot at first responders. And that’s not all – while the Washington legislature was passing a law to ban high-capacity magazines, my opponent tried and failed to pass carve-outs to the law.

For generations, the Sixth District has been represented by gun safety champions. In Congress, I will work to strengthen background checks, fund community violence prevention programs, and close loopholes that allow abusers and criminals to access firearms. I know we don’t have to choose between keeping our children safe and responsible gun ownership. We can’t go backward – we must ensure this seat stays in the hands of a Democrat who will fight for common-sense gun safety laws, not against them.

subject: America just passed a major milestone:

body:
I ran for Senate to be the 51st Democrat — the 51st vote to confirm President Biden’s judges.
#
Derek, America just passed a major milestone:
The Senate just confirmed President Biden’s 200th federal judge! 🎉
Now, I get it — to a lot of folks, this might sound like some DC inside-baseball wonk bullshit. But I can tell you that _who_ fills those judicial vacancies _really_ matters.
Federal judges have the power to uphold (or strike down) _every single law_ that Congress passes. Unhinged right-wing extreme judges strike down laws that protect our rights, our families, and our workers; fair-minded mainstream judges uphold those laws.
So yeah, this is a big deal. I ran for Senate to be the 51st Democrat — the 51st vote to confirm President Biden’s judges. **[If you want to make sure that I can keep confirming Democratic judges for years to come, please chip in $5 here!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240612?refcode=em20240612-2-9100&refcode2=9100_434096_jQknbj&akid=9100%2E434096%2EjQknbj)**

Derek, we’ve got to keep going — for the rest of this year (and then four more years!💪) I’ll continue being _the deciding vote_ for President Biden’s judges.
**[By supporting me you’re helping to rebalance the courts — you’re doing your part to undo the damage that Trump’s ridiculous judges have done — so please pitch in $5 today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240612?refcode=em20240612-2-9100&refcode2=9100_434096_jQknbj&akid=9100%2E434096%2EjQknbj)**

Thanks!
❤️ John

Fellow Conservative,

I’ve been thinking about this question for a while and thought perhaps now is the right time to ask you: **What are you looking for in a U.S. senator?**

body:
https://jenaforcolorado.com/ [https://jenaforcolorado.com/]
Peter,
As we commemorate Pride Month this June, I am proud to celebrate the vibrant and resilient LGBTQ+ community right here in Colorado.
From Denver to Boulder, Colorado Springs to Fort Collins, the LGBTQ+ community contributes to the richness of our culture, economy, and society as a whole. Our state has enacted policies to protect and empower the LBGTQ+ community, such as prohibiting discrimination in places of public accommodation, housing, and employment based on sexual orientation or gender identity.
Although we’ve moved forward, the fight for full equality is far from over. LGBTQ+ Coloradans still face challenges, including disparities in healthcare access, higher rates of homelessness among youth, and ongoing discrimination in various aspects of life.
As your Secretary of State, I will always support Colorado's LGBTQ+ community and advocate for policies that promote equality, dignity, and respect for all. Together, we will continue working to ensure that every person in Colorado can live authentically, without fear of discrimination or prejudice.
During this Pride Month and beyond, let us celebrate the diversity and resilience of our LGBTQ+ community and recommit ourselves to building a more inclusive and equitable Colorado for all.
Happy Pride Month!
– Jena Griswold

Derek, there
are a few life lessons almost universal to the human condition that we
learn growing up.

The Golden Rule — to treat others the way you would want to be treated.

Not to lie, cheat, or steal.

Honesty is the best policy.

Good manners go a long way.

You don’t always get what you want.

Success comes from hard work.

It’s not always about you.

They might sound cliché, but after the decade of Donald Trump in our
politics, when his immorality and indecency have infected so much of the
country, aren’t we in need of some back-to-basics?

We need leaders who follow the letter of the law and abide by our
Constitution.

And at the end of the day, we just need people who are decent human
beings.

Leaders who treat others with respect. Leaders with honesty and integrity.

Leaders who understand what it’s like to walk a mile in another’s shoes
and won’t give up fighting for what’s right just to take the easy road
Trump has made for the greedy and self-interested.

Right matters. Truth matters. Our democracy matters. That’s what this
campaign is about.

body:
Get up to date on what's new and noteworthy. | | | | |

---
|

| **Pickard Fish Fry Event**
Come out in support of Ronald Pickard in his race for Delegate to Congress!
Date: June 15thTime: 11 am - 2 pmLocation: Across the street from Roof Tops on St Croix
* To pre-order your food call 321-297-3892
---
|
---
| **RPVI Primary Update**
Elections Supervisor Caroline Fawkes and the Board of Elections have decided to hold a primary election exclusively for the Democratic Party.
On May 22nd, the RPVI State Committee convened and approved a process for candidate nomination. Each candidate will receive a vote and they are nominated by a majority vote on what candidates who filed as Republican will represent the Republican Party in the Virgin Islands for their respective positions.
---
[Read More](https://republicanpartyinthevirginislands.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aec4429d4907d8f643606ded&id=b43f13bad5&e=4f81ceec6f)
|
---
| **New St Croix Office**
With a generous donation from the Pickard family and the help of Valerie Stiles, RPVI is happy to announce that we have secured a location for a new office on St Croix.
Details and visiting hours will be announced when the office has been fully furnished and staffed.
---
|
---
| **National Convention Tribute**
The Republican National Convention will honor the memories of those we have lost since the 2016 Convention.
We invite you to participate in this meaningful tribute by submitting the names of individuals from our territory whom you wish to see honored. Please submit your entries by 5:00 PM CT on Friday, June 14, 2024.
You can submit an entry via [this form.](https://republicanpartyinthevirginislands.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aec4429d4907d8f643606ded&id=682651f759&e=4f81ceec6f)
---

| **Trump v.s. Biden National Polling**
In key battleground states, Trump holds an advantage, leading Biden by an average of .5 percentage points. Current polling suggests that Trump has solid support in critical battleground states that could determine the election outcome (RealClearPolls).

The Supreme Court is out of control.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86775881/478983144/-1463099547?refcode=-header-&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWRmMDNkY2EtZmQyOC1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=zLCQe2o-pFS43w--2HHiX7ftHkW_R8paNQnY8_jC8hs=) | Peter, What in the world is happening at our Supreme Court? I’m almost in disbelief at what I’m hearing. First Justice Alito was immersed in controversy when he blamed his wife for flying a stop the steal flag (aka a pro-January 6th flag) in response to a neighbor’s pride flag. Now newly-released recordings reveal the truth about his intentions. He agreed with an activist that we have to return our country to a place of “Godliness” and that they can’t negotiate with “the left.” **“One side or the other is going to win,” he said.** When I was in school, I was taught that the Supreme Court’s job was to be impartial and above politics. But here we have a Supreme Court justice, in his own words, openly encouraging political division in our country. Not to mention Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas, who received undisclosed gifts from a billionaire GOP donor while his wife was texting Trump's chief of staff on January 6th. **This is why I support a new bill called the Supreme Court Ethics Act. This will establish new rules including a judicial code of conduct for all judges and justices of U.S. courts, including Supreme Court justices.** [_**We need your help to show how much support this bill really has! body:
You and I both know that every life is a precious gift.
__
Stop the Biden Administration's radical abortion agenda! | | | | _Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=8f0948a19641456ebaeeaf4fa4585e95&_t=fgow0_MuHHMgeYiksgg45-Rs-MTjbWexzjav_bcgK0LV3aVsTypat-DSGNyb28CRnZzYAMpSW-_gbaSN8JbHpB-2OhwuipsrNejS3neBTURG315WyyMsiU15eOBlvsVE)_

| |
Dear Fellow American,

It's Sarah Huckabee Sanders, Governor of Arkansas.

You and I both know that every life is a precious gift. Yet, the Biden Administration continues to threaten the innocent and the voiceless under the guise of reproductive rights.

Every day, they press ahead with policies that expand access to dangerous abortion drugs and allow abortion-on-demand, resulting in countless, unthinkable losses of innocent life. The danger to future generations, the heartbreaking impact on families, and the erosion of our most fundamental values as Americans are at stake.

But we don't have to accept this reality. There is a solution, and you are a key part of it.

I am proud to join forces with SBA Pro-Life America, the most principled and effective organization fighting to end abortion in our country. By advocating for legislation that serves women and saves babies, SBA Pro-Life America stands at the forefront of this battle for life.

**But our effectiveness relies on dedicated individuals like YOU. YOUR voice matters. YOUR actions matter.**

That's why I'm personally inviting you to join us by signing the Stand For Life Pledge. This is a powerful way for us to demonstrate that, together, we form a strong, nationwide coalition poised to protect life, challenge policies that devalue it, and promote a culture that cherishes the value of every human life.

As a pro-life American, would you step forward today and sign our Pledge for Life? You can do so at the link below:

[https://action.sbaprolife.org/sarah-huckabee-sanders](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=8f0948a19641456ebaeeaf4fa4585e95&_e=nBpiii6V9b4NMPTMkbLR0-l2f2PQj392tR0QXn7-TmylfOBwB2UPiQLdZOy_gyzKj7NWM4AaOKF-1DTtZUZPbysiQr9vE2TLOyNNwglae8ZOV6EpQprvX9DD3LrxQLcIpK-JwA_Up6m8dtej2n5_WaP5pFLQdnsbfKoRoML4ydiHY8Z-Q3UoHd075XdNMTtL9hzHxnGhZEUjcHewo8tENb3gd9Ud52WMY_1pPu2vhrxp73BoEqhk0x2T4d20W_dQKvvLLC2F4rIeWRAWdr7FkhZlP8xjhAd5jYob1mHWwbL4NqX1l7InEdv94Uz6rHqOi8gnJBEnWU7NKfhRlc9d4yUiRkFk8LAKSJnp3XnCKy30UtMBjcbXHU75ENBeZGPg)

Together, we can protect the future and build a pro-life America. Thank you for standing with us and for acting on your beliefs - because it's in these actions that change truly begins.

God bless you,

Sarah Huckabee Sanders
Governor of Arkansas

Just last week, Senate Republicans tanked a bill that would have codified nearly six decades of contraceptive precedent under _Griswold v. Connecticut_ into law.

As if denying the right to contraceptives wasn't enough, their decision comes after Trump said he would go after birth control if he won the White House in November.

It's only been two years since _Roe_ was overturned, but the GOP is showing no signs of stopping their radical agenda to control women's bodily autonomy. Enough is enough. We cannot remain silent as Republicans chip away at our reproductive rights.

As the first pediatrician in Congress, Kim is doing her part to protect our rights to reproductive care, but she can't do it alone.

While abortions happen for various reasons, any choice made should always remain between a woman and her doctor. launches attacks with a complete disregard for the people of Gaza,
Democratic leaders Chuck Schumer and Hakeem Jeffries invited Netanyahu to
speak in front of Congress. The Israeli military recently killed 274
Palestinians during a raid in Gaza — a shocking death toll.

Netanyahu is obstructing all efforts to broker a Ceasefire. His actions
show he would rather continue waging war to kill Palestinians in order to
free hostages rather than negotiate a diplomatic peace deal that would
save lives, free hostages, and end this horrific war.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18064?t=1013&akid=6157%2E5885482%2ExyMDtP ]Add your name: Schumer and Jeffries may have invited Netanyahu, but
Democrats can choose the moral, courageous position of Peace. Boycott
Netanyahu’s speech!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18065?source=email-20240612&t=1014&akid=6157%2E5885482%2ExyMDtP ]ADD YOUR NAME

Why did the Democratic leaders in the House and Senate invite Netanyahu to
speak? Why are Democrats like President Biden still actively supporting
Netanyahu with a platform in the United States and billions of dollars of
funding and bombs? We should NEVER have to ask these questions, but our
government continues to hold the morally bankrupt position of supporting
Netanyahu’s atrocities in Gaza with funding, bombs, and Congressional
invites.

Schumer and Jeffries have given legitimacy to Netanyahu’s regime AND
handed the right-wing liars in Congress major political points. GOP
Speaker Mike Johnson has been saying Bernie is “siding with terrorists” by
not attending this speech. The politics around this speech are disgusting,
and Democratic leadership rubber-stamped all of it with their lack of
courage.

Schumer and Jeffries never should have signed their names alongside
Johnson and Mitch McConnell. It’s a gift to the GOP and the head of the
regime killing so many people in Gaza.

When we organize, we win.

subject: Did you see what Jamaal’s opponent said this time, Peter?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Conservative AIPAC-backed candidate George Latimer is at it again (“it”
being racism, Islamophobia, and homophobia),
Peter.

On Monday during a debate in NY-16’s competitive Democratic primary race,
Latimer used more dog whistles to attack progressive Rep. Jamaal Bowman:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240612.lfldzv&refcode=em20240612-35262&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=35262%2E1203867%2EUeh5vV ]Retweet by AOC: Just so we’re clear, this is a stunningly racist and
homophobic thing to say. Tweet by Bryan Metzger: This was the point during
the LWV debate where George Latimer said to Jamaal Bowman: “Your
constituency is Dearborn, Michigan, your constituency is San Francisco,
California.”

AOC is right: These are bigoted comments from Latimer, who has directed
multiple racist, Islamophobic insults at Jamaal for his pro-peace,
pro-ceasefire stance throughout this race.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240612.lfldzv&refcode=em20240612-35262&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=35262%2E1203867%2EUeh5vV ]With less than two weeks left until the primary election, will you rush
$5 to fund Justice Democrats’ work to help Jamaal fight
back and win?

We can’t say we’re surprised by Latimer’s offensive attacks. AIPAC — the
supposedly bipartisan anti-Palestinian lobby group that funded and picked
Latimer to challenge Jamaal — only spends against (mostly Black and brown)
incumbents in Democratic primaries.

Their super PAC has dropped more than $10 million against Jamaal so far,
making this the most expensive House primary in U.S. history. And with 13
days until the election, we know they’re not finished yet.

Like Washington Post columnist Karen Attiah said this week:

“It’s hard to overstate the importance of the Bowman vs. Latimer showdown
for progressives. The outcome represents much more than just the issue of
money in politics. It raises concerns about right-wing money being
funneled into Democratic primaries and tests the ability of AIPAC to
shield Israel from criticism. But bigger than that, it is a test of how
far America’s right wing will go to crush progressive movements. No one
should be surprised that a Black politician is the canary in the coal
mine.”

AIPAC’s network is using tens of millions of dollars from the same
anti-abortion, anti-ceasefire, pro-insurrection donors who support Donald
Trump to try and oust progressives like Jamaal. We can’t let them
succeed, Peter.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240612.lfldzv&refcode=em20240612-35262&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=35262%2E1203867%2EUeh5vV ]Please, pitch in ANY amount right now to fuel our efforts to re-elect
Jamaal and stop the far right from meddling in our Democratic primaries!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240612.lfldzv&refcode=em20240612-35262&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1022&akid=35262%2E1203867%2EUeh5vV ]Contribute $5

Anything you can contribute will help us go up against AIPAC and Latimer’s
war chest in the final days of this critical race.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Peter, there’s a lot to worry about right now.

**Step two:** Exhale. All will be well.

name: Chuck Morse
subject: Education Freedom Forum - TOMORROW
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Chuck Morse, Dan Norris Treasurer
body:
Join us for an important discussion on education choice!
| | | |
---
| | Derek,
Tomorrow we're hosting an forum on education freedom and you're Invited!

As part of my campaign for Governor, I am committed to ensuring that every child has the opportunity to succeed by expanding universal education choice. **This is a critical election because every other candidate in the race has a history of opposing education choice.**
As Senate President, I was proud to lead the passage of Education Freedom Accounts, bringing greater flexibility and opportunities to families across our state. Now, I am advocating for a universal approach, believing that every family should have the ability to choose the best educational path for their children.
Join us at the forum to:
* Learn about the benefits of education choice and how it empowers families in New Hampshire.
* Discuss the successes of our current initiatives and explore the potential of universal implementation.
* Hear from experts, parents, and educators about the transformative impact of educational freedom.

Your voice and perspective are crucial as we shape the future of our educational landscape. Let's come together to fight for our children's futures with facts! The Forum will include special guest speakers including Senator Ruth Ward and Director of the Children's Scholarship Fund of New Hampshire, Kate Baker.
I look forward to seeing you at the forum and working together to make New Hampshire a leader in educational choice.
In Liberty, Chuck Morse

Did you know the federal government spends $1.9 trillion on healthcare annually? Effective healthcare reforms can save nearly half of these costs.

Friends,
Imagine the possibilities and inspiration from what we could achieve with hundreds of billions saved annually.

I'm fighting for universal healthcare because after 40 years as a doctor, social worker, medical director, and educator of physicians, I know how truly broken this system is.

Leaders We Deserve has now endorsed twelve young candidates across the United States.
| Folks,

Leaders We Deserve has endorsed twelve young candidates across the United States, who are energized and ready to take on the fight of our generation. They represent some of the best of our generation and the future of the Democratic Party. Here’s a map to show where exactly we are focusing our efforts this election cycle: [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/70177?t=6&akid=15106%2E878179%2Ey3lXXF) [**These young leaders are ready to bring positive change to their communities and we are leaving no stone unturned to make sure they get that opportunity. Can you split $10 today between us and Voter Protection Project to make sure nothing stands in our way of electing the Leaders We DESERVE?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/70177?t=7&akid=15106%2E878179%2Ey3lXXF) | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/70177?t=8&akid=15106%2E878179%2Ey3lXXF)

| Peter,

Growing up, my parents — my father, a veteran and career law enforcement officer, and my mother, a nurse — instilled in me a deep devotion to our country and an abiding commitment to service.

When I first ran for Congress in 2018 – flipping this seat blue for the first time in 50 years – I spoke often of a letter my parents wrote to my sisters and me. In it, they wrote out lessons for their daughters, one of which has been a driving message throughout my life:

_**“There is no greater vocation than service to your country.”**_

Throughout my career, I’ve been guided by this message as I’ve served this country, first, as a federal law enforcement officer working narcotics and money laundering cases. Then, I worked at the CIA as a case officer, where I worked undercover to combat terrorism and keep Americans safe.

**In Congress, my commitment has always been clear: putting Virginians first.** I've strived to address the needs of Virginians every day since I was elected, but I know there’s so much more we can do.

Now, during my campaign for Governor, I’ve heard from so many of you on the issues that matter most. Together, we can expand economic opportunity for everyone, strengthen our schools, keep our communities safe, and protect the fundamental rights of all Virginians.

clean_body: In Congress, my commitment has always been clear: putting Virginians first. I've strived to address the needs of Virginians every day since I was elected, but I know there’s so much more we can do. | = | Peter, Growing up, my parents — my father, a veteran and career law enforcement officer, and my mother, a nurse — instilled in me a deep devotion to our country and an abiding commitment to service. When I first ran for Congress in 2018 – flipping this seat blue for the first time in 50 years – I spoke often of a letter my parents wrote to my sisters and me. In it, they wrote out lessons for their daughters, one of which has been a driving message throughout my life: “There is no greater vocation than service to your country.” Throughout my career, I’ve been guided by this message as I’ve served this country, first, as a federal law enforcement officer working narcotics and money laundering cases. Then, I worked at the CIA as a case officer, where I worked undercover to combat terrorism and keep Americans safe. In Congress, my commitment has always been clear: putting Virginians first. I've strived to address the needs of Virginians every day since I was elected, but I know there’s so much more we can do. Now, during my campaign for Governor, I’ve heard from so many of you on the issues that matter most. Together, we can expand economic opportunity for everyone, strengthen our schools, keep our communities safe, and protect the fundamental rights of all Virginians. = | = | = | = | = | = Thank you, Abigail P.S. In case you are wondering, here are just a few of the other lessons on my parents’ list: “Correct what is wrong and maintain what is right” “Be proud of what you have honestly earned, be it small or large” “Use your skills and intellect for worthwhile causes” “Regardless of its low price, if you don’t need it, it’s not a bargain” “Have fun, but not at the expense of others” And the one that their three sons-in-law hear the most, “you can always take your tie off”, which is meant both metaphorically and literally, and when taken literally, it also means that one must start with a tie on! * | | Paid for by Spanberger for Governor Spanberger for Governor P.O. Requiring an ID in order to vote isn't a radical concept. In fact, it's a common practice.

Friend,

Requiring an ID in order to vote – isn't some radical idea. In fact, it's quite common:

[ ](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=d60ab86eb83447f4b386a7ddfb8b0d3d&_e=x8BwJRjTv1UKgBpb-ATKcAh4FRaj36iplO0DTfFEfEA_SVlROgo9dHY1b8WQLg21_BKK8Gt4S3Hb1lydDYtUsfFxaW8Zi4t_5RuVAsYl_EQj6XauO3z1MmPsMWdNddesVtyW7fJA2uKYsmRPqE5H8cGe3xE0d2Y9K_Sb5cgxl-pgJ_dN00r7yKd5MbxGtnEXrFWuZC0khE1rFOVd2bHzGbe7bkJ1jku8wvImJpwGyRRsxZaM0VobUn659C2BtJhWyShBj249AJRJtW4L2d95L3Cf1M4Ma1spi8yPYWqARiQWnAmqGn56G6coYCUydASS9Mzqu3gClZkNKPvAvnz9QlbE5KADJj9eSP9yC8ehBh-kLdLTZx5UrebFP8i3UzxI)
Usually Big Government loves requiring IDs. Big Government INSISTS that IDs are required for buying guns (our 2A Right), hunting and fishing (our livelihood) – but DRAW THE LINE when it comes to requiring one for voting.

The reason is really quite simple and it's also quite disturbing.

Democrats want to register as many non-citizens as they can and have them vote in - AND INFLUENCE - our elections.

ALL WITHOUT REQUIRING AN ID TO DO IT.

This is wrong and why my team is focused on getting the SAVE ACT passed and PROTECTING OUR ELECTIONS.

Will you chip in $1 so I have enough resources to fight the opposition and get legislation passed that WILL SAVE OUR ELECTIONS: **[LeeforSenate.com/save-act](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=d60ab86eb83447f4b386a7ddfb8b0d3d&_e=x8BwJRjTv1UKgBpb-ATKcAh4FRaj36iplO0DTfFEfEA_SVlROgo9dHY1b8WQLg21_BKK8Gt4S3Hb1lydDYtUsfFxaW8Zi4t_5RuVAsYl_EQj6XauO3z1MmPsMWdNddesVtyW7fJA2uKYsmRPqE5H8cGe3xE0d2Y9K_Sb5cgxl-pgJ_dN00r7yKd5MbxGtnEX28Zzoaptx0TrLNEnvp9RuII4Pnm2xEFeevPjf_J08HQa-uwqdaZHyBnKfaqKjhJN0V9c6G2-DglWq2fvGQHNCcPO-Sdjj1ftv61Amzf5mxrszGXiPAZXVWMPlB0rbkUIauwAxdtoTTjP3VrnjMHb2Ver46BYlUgGRhlWxAk0DvIxrDofQPj-CG7WKkgS0Z6_CHU_RofCTchBc_P0RsjZMg%3D%3D)**

We require an ID to get on a plane, visit the doctor, or go to the bank. Basic things. But we DON'T when it comes to one of the most important things we do – VOTING.

| | Today, I put together a quick list of what we need in order to win in Georgia in 2024. This isn’t an exhaustive list by any means, but I wanted to give you a look into what kinds of things we’re planning and what we need to do to win.

* Organizers in every county across the state
* A top-notch traditional and digital communications program
* A leadership institute that will train our candidates on how to run winning campaigns
* The best voter protection team in the entire country
* A statewide network of grassroots volunteers

[](https://click.act.democrats.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvpOShxPWr9mFhJMw1S-wTtvhltHWfNwNtDIaYBJbNv2OiYGsvOb7Ojyb0iUS8Qi3TVPJPA9e7NbeQuRZxm78DFu71QPFzVJkxJ9B0--e_2ILMCoSpvN0-6ttTk-fpLLcaltm8E6WTm7AZQ5aHapJfwxDRfpSyvWJOgUdvUpfDwDvkSJSohXqRKIIaS-8yFsrCVxZRPRt0Yun--HCBHGi-_rHa9mQ8KUA2EVlG8vuPUjKzk2CUfOl4Fk_Xy-iOt3sdP7a1ps3IXibN1jnyNN-uNgC2EY_MIL4aISlJiFPHPcKDz_kuBck6R-Z6Jf_FPU5Pj1KIpZ-UD4zVTKctIU8OAmuQbBlO9JNqPU65bgcMeVcJKkFKm-yLlVzCKWox8M7Q/475/l2y4MH2vSKKKBGqpN7u9NA/h0/h001.MwkU5bnM7C2QFa-rVcOJFqTZNoukbC-_uUwsa6up8xQ) Eight years ago, America woke up to the news of another mass shooting, this time at Pulse Nightclub in Orlando, Florida. But as the hours passed and the news trickled in, it became clear that this one was different. Later that day we learned why: The tragedy at Pulse was a hate-fueled attack against LGBTQ+ and Latino people that left 49 dead and dozens more wounded. In the weeks that followed, some legislators tried to force action. There was Congressman John Lewis’s sit-in on the House floor. With the help of his colleagues, Senator Chris Murphy led a dramatic gun violence prevention filibuster that ultimately forced a vote on background checks. It did not pass then, but we continued to fight. We fought to elect leaders who would prioritize the safety of our communities over the profits of gun manufacturers. And we fought to convince our elected officials it was beyond time to act. And then, finally, we passed the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act. It is the most significant gun safety legislation in nearly 30 years, and President Joe Biden signed it into law. But our work is not done. If we are going to continue to make any additional progress, we need to defeat Donald Trump and elect gun safety champions to the House and Senate. The DNC is one of the organizations best positioned to help get that done. So I am asking: [**Can you please make today the day you contribute $7 to the Democratic National Committee to help defeat Donald Trump and elect Democrats up and down the ballot this fall?**](https://click.act.democrats.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvpOShxPWr9mFhJMw1S-wTtvhltHWfNwNtDIaYBJbNv2OiYGsvOb7Ojyb0iUS8Qi3TVPJPA9e7NbeQuRZxm78DFu71QPFzVJkxJ9B0--e_2ILMCoSpvN0-6ttTk-fpLLcYuloGPqoxSjJqy0D9hSC5aTGLJtr6waZVxsWOXUfVfacU3_hPhWAW98O1rdDcZJ1FBBcUDWszlPO2GW2aOZO72Zn1Y_f-WeaSNpW8dgivNWRCVua_TGk6ZYxjOnl9XeWOhd9oKw_ZQOD4g468cTuT1wYpDdmMH7lSCn_WnhxPWgbAzJBjwItFGwwXA5FlWgwa3BWs1EKPNvrZLsBy2PdpJT4kfZyBds-4XGVZgPf9cCQ71QBtIcV4tKMA1uGxkCHI/475/l2y4MH2vSKKKBGqpN7u9NA/h1/h001.TMsf2DZy9R7x6H0rWOhRCypWzmACzp695_34yTBabe8)

name: Sherrod
subject: What desk 88 means to me
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY FRIENDS OF SHERROD BROWN
body:
| | | Friend, it's a well-known tradition for senators to carve their names in the drawers of their desks in the Senate – some of which have been around since the early 1800s. It's perhaps a bit less well-known that we also get to choose our desks when we first get elected. Even though they're all technically the same, this was a decision I took pretty seriously.
---
**When I saw the names on desk 88, I knew I had found my Senate home.** Including Robert F. Kennedy, Al Gore Sr., and George McGovern, the progressive senators who preceded me at this desk all fought to make our country a better, more equal place. They helped end segregation, protested the Vietnam War, and fought against wealth disparity. Their legacies inspire me to keep fighting for American families and the Dignity of Work.
**But the truth is, I'm now in urgent need of your help to keep up this fight.**

Our future progress hinges on defending our Democratic majority – which could all come down to my toss-up race in Ohio. The GOP knows this, which is why Mitch McConnell has named me a top target for defeat, and why GOP special interests are gearing up to spend millions to flip this seat.
**I'm committed to continuing the righteous fights of those who sat at desk 88 before me – but I can't do so without your support. clean_body: | | | Friend, it's a well-known tradition for senators to carve their names in the drawers of their desks in the Senate – some of which have been around since the early 1800s. It's perhaps a bit less well-known that we also get to choose our desks when we first get elected. Even though they're all technically the same, this was a decision I took pretty seriously. When I saw the names on desk 88, I knew I had found my Senate home. Including Robert F. Kennedy, Al Gore Sr., and George McGovern, the progressive senators who preceded me at this desk all fought to make our country a better, more equal place. They helped end segregation, protested the Vietnam War, and fought against wealth disparity. Their legacies inspire me to keep fighting for American families and the Dignity of Work. But the truth is, I'm now in urgent need of your help to keep up this fight. Our future progress hinges on defending our Democratic majority – which could all come down to my toss-up race in Ohio. The GOP knows this, which is why Mitch McConnell has named me a top target for defeat, and why GOP special interests are gearing up to spend millions to flip this seat. I'm committed to continuing the righteous fights of those who sat at desk 88 before me – but I can't do so without your support. = Thank you, = | | = | Please read on for a personal message from Sen. Hi Peter, Senator Tammy Baldwin here.

This month marks 55 years since the New York City Police Department raided Stonewall Inn, a bar in the city’s Greenwich Village and safe haven for the LGBTQ+ community.

Several brave Americans, led by Black and brown trans activists, fought back against police violence and harassment. Demonstrations throughout the city happened over the span of six days, kickstarting the modern LGBTQ+ movement for equal rights.

Stonewall is a story of those who came before us and put everything on the line in a demand to be treated with dignity and respect. Those who bravely stood up and spoke out so that others wouldn’t have to live in fear or silence.

Progress was made possible by the Black and brown trans activists who have always been on the frontlines of the fight for LGBTQ+ rights. We must never forget that.

I’m inspired by how far we’ve come in the past 55 years, but as Republicans continue their assault on LGBTQ+ rights — targeting and dehumanizing trans kids, banning LGBTQ+ discussion in our schools, and even threatening to overturn Supreme Court decisions that granted our right to marriage equality — it’s clear there is so much more work to be done.

It’s going to take all of us to counter these right wing attacks and ensure LGBTQ+ Americans across the country are given the support and equal opportunities they deserve.

Just yesterday, Katie Porter introduced FIVE keys pieces of legislation that will help Congress more effectively for the American people and curb the influence of special interest groups in our government.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38906%2E3422442%2EAe5SJe)
Derek,
Katie’s time in Congress may be coming to an end in January, but she is still hard at work for the American people—would you expect anything different?
Just yesterday, Katie Porter introduced FIVE key bills that will help Congress work more effectively for the American people and curb the influence of special interests in our government.
Americans deserve a Congress that works for us—not for special interests or a politician’s personal profit. **[Will you contribute $5 to Truth to Power to support Katie’s work to elect more leaders who will carry the fight to end special interest influence in Washington?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240612?refcode=em20240612-38906&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38906_3422442_Ae5SJe&akid=38906%2E3422442%2EAe5SJe)**
Here’s a rundown of the five pieces of legislation Katie introduced yesterday:
1) The _Legislative Proxy and Absence Accommodation Resolution_ will allow Members to once again vote by proxy in the case of illness or another unavoidable absence, keeping Congress running and giving Americans the representation we deserve.
2) The _Majority Rule Resolution_ ends the filibuster, which has prevented Congress from passing legislation that is broadly popular with a majority of the American people.
3) The _Congressional Bipartisan Seating Resolution_ would set in stone a bipartisan recommendation to alternate seating of Members’ party affiliation during committee hearings. This will foster a more collaborative working environment between both parties.
4) The _Lobbying Disclosure Modernization Act_ would finally consolidate information about who is lobbying in Congress into one accessible platform for public viewing. This would increase transparency and trust.
5) The _Block the Revolving Door Act_ would institute a two-year ban on lobbying for former Members of Congress and other high-level government employees.
Katie is focused on the future of our country, because she’s seen how desperately we need to enact real change.
**[If you can, will you contribute $5 to help Katie support the next wave of leaders who will continue her fights in Congress for transparency and accountability?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240612?refcode=em20240612-38906&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38906_3422442_Ae5SJe&akid=38906%2E3422442%2EAe5SJe)**

Peter,
On this day eight years ago, 49 people were murdered at the Pulse nightclub in Orlando, Florida, in what would become the deadliest mass shooting in the United States at that time.
The shooting once again put the spotlight on America’s gun violence epidemic and highlighted attacks against the LGBTQ+ community — an increasing number of which have become violent.
**In the eight years since, the assault on LGBTQ+ rights has only ramped up.**
Across the country, anti-LGBTQ+ lawmakers have advanced and passed several discriminatory bills, including those that target access to gender-affirming care, so-called bathroom bills, and anti-trans sports bans.
And while there is no indication that the current wave of homophobic legislation will end in the short-term, we’re more committed than ever before to electing the leaders we deserve — leaders who will advance LGBTQ+ equality, not erase it.
Thank you for reading,
— Leaders We Deserve

* Kane County was once considered a Republican stronghold. Working with a coalition of different groups, we got back to the basics of voter contact. Knocking on doors, going to parades, talking to voters, and showing that the Democratic Party is growing. It didn’t happen overnight but now the Kane County Republican Party is almost nonexistent. I want to take this plan statewide to help all of our counties build stronger County Parties like we did in Kane County.
* We will make sure that Joe Biden gets re-elected.
* We will help Democrats retake control of Congress, which starts by sending back all Democratic members of the Illinois Congressional Delegation.
* And we must return the supermajorities to Springfield for Speaker Welch and President Harmon to continue supporting Governor JB Pritzker’s agenda.

As you know, electing Democrats up and down the ballot – especially in places considered Republican strongholds – is difficult and expensive. clean_body: = Team, I’m honored to be reaching out to you today after being unanimously elected President of the Illinois Democratic County Chairs’ Association this past weekend. As you know, I took over as Interim President in January of this year – and I am grateful for the trust our members have in me to lead our organization for the next 2 years. = = Now, I want to talk to you about my agenda for the next 2 years: Kane County was once considered a Republican stronghold. Working with a coalition of different groups, we got back to the basics of voter contact. Knocking on doors, going to parades, talking to voters, and showing that the Democratic Party is growing. It didn’t happen overnight but now the Kane County Republican Party is almost nonexistent. I want to take this plan statewide to help all of our counties build stronger County Parties like we did in Kane County. We will make sure that Joe Biden gets re-elected. We will help Democrats retake control of Congress, which starts by sending back all Democratic members of the Illinois Congressional Delegation. And we must return the supermajorities to Springfield for Speaker Welch and President Harmon to continue supporting Governor JB Pritzker’s agenda. As you know, electing Democrats up and down the ballot – especially in places considered Republican strongholds – is difficult and expensive. subject: A downturn at a dangerous time
disclaimer_text: Paid for by End Citizens United-Nonfederal
body:
We’re in a make-or-break moment. So we’re writing to you with an urgent, critical request
| [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/26910?t=1&akid=21535%2E4449941%2EGVtZke)
---
Team, we’re seeing a major downturn in our fundraising.

That downturn could not be coming at a worse time. If you’ve got a minute, please... let us explain why this is so dangerous for us.

For the last few months we’ve had really strong fundraising. We’ve outraised Kari Lake, we’ve had some strong showings in the polls, and we found ourselves in a strong position to win this election.

We made plans based on that performance. We reserved millions of dollars in advertising in the home stretch of the election — millions of dollars that we predicted we’d be able to raise, and millions that we’re on the hook for.

But our fundraising this month... it’s just not been great. We’re not sure why, but folks just aren’t giving like they used to.

And the timing — it’s absolutely terrible. Because not only are we on the hook for millions in ads, Kari Lake just announced that she is spending $10 million dollars on television against us.

**TEN MILLION DOLLARS, team.**

It’s huge. And if we’re not careful, that kind of advertising could swamp us. This is win-lose territory. And if we lose, that means Kari Lake in a Senate held by the Republicans.

We’re in a make-or-break moment. So we’re writing to you with an urgent, critical request: [**Please, split an online donation with Fight for Reform before our deadline hits. Help us catch up on our goals so we can fight back against Kari Lake and the tidal wave of attack ads coming our way and help Fight for Reform elect state and local Democrats.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/44659?t=7&akid=21535%2E4449941%2EGVtZke) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Ruben Gallego will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/44660?t=8&akid=21535%2E4449941%2EGVtZke)
